/-- `|u| E(u) ≤ 0.37`: with `s = eᵘ`, `≤ s² e^{−s²} ≤ 1/e` for `s ≤ 1` and `≤ s⁴e^{−s²}/e ≤ 4/e³`
for `s ≥ 1`. -/
theorem abs_mul_Ew_le (u : ℝ) : |u| * Ew u ≤ 0.37 := by
  have he := Real.exp_one_gt_d9
  set s := Real.exp u with hs
  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.exp_pos u
  have hE : Ew u = s ^ 3 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) := rfl
  rcases le_or_gt u 0 with hu | hu
  · -- `|u| = −u ≤ e^{−u}`, so `|u| E ≤ s² e^{−s²} ≤ e^{−1}`
    have h1 : -u ≤ Real.exp (-u) := by have := Real.add_one_le_exp (-u); linarith
    have h2 : Real.exp (-u) * s = 1 := by rw [hs, ← Real.exp_add]; simp
    have h3 : s ^ 2 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) ≤ Real.exp (-1) := by
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (s ^ 2 - 1)
      have e1 : Real.exp (s ^ 2 - 1) * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) = Real.exp (-1) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
      have := Real.exp_pos (-s ^ 2)
      nlinarith
    have h4 : Real.exp (-1) ≤ 0.37 := by
      rw [Real.exp_neg, inv_le_comm₀ (Real.exp_pos 1) (by norm_num)]; norm_num; linarith
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hu, hE]
    have hE0 : 0 ≤ s ^ 3 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) := by positivity
    calc -u * (s ^ 3 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2)) ≤ Real.exp (-u) * (s ^ 3 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hE0
      _ = s ^ 2 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) * (Real.exp (-u) * s) := by ring
      _ = s ^ 2 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) := by rw [h2, mul_one]
      _ ≤ 0.37 := h3.trans h4
  · -- `u ≤ e^{u−1} = s/e`, so `|u| E ≤ s⁴ e^{−s²}/e ≤ 4/e³`
    have h1 : u ≤ Real.exp (u - 1) := by have := Real.add_one_le_exp (u - 1); linarith
    have h2 : Real.exp (u - 1) = s * Real.exp (-1) := by rw [hs, ← Real.exp_add]; ring_nf
    have h3 : s ^ 4 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-2) := by
      have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (s ^ 2 / 2 - 1)
      have hp : 0 ≤ s ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
      have hsq : (s ^ 2 / 2) ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (s ^ 2 / 2 - 1) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hp (by linarith) 2
      have e1 : Real.exp (s ^ 2 / 2 - 1) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) = Real.exp (-2) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
      have := Real.exp_pos (-s ^ 2)
      nlinarith
    have h4 : 4 * Real.exp (-2) * Real.exp (-1) ≤ 0.37 := by
      rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
      have : Real.exp (-2 + -1) = (Real.exp 1 ^ 3)⁻¹ := by
        rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_neg]; congr 1; norm_num
      rw [this]
      have : (2.7 : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ Real.exp 1 ^ 3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by linarith) 3
      rw [mul_inv_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]; nlinarith
    rw [abs_of_pos hu, hE]
    have hE0 : 0 ≤ s ^ 3 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) := by positivity
    calc u * (s ^ 3 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2)) ≤ Real.exp (u - 1) * (s ^ 3 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hE0
      _ = s ^ 4 * Real.exp (-s ^ 2) * Real.exp (-1) := by rw [h2]; ring
      _ ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-2) * Real.exp (-1) :=

theorem abs_etaPlus_le_A {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : |etaPlus t| ≤ 1.94 := by
  unfold etaPlus
  rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ht, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  have h1 := abs_hH200_le ht
  have h2 := mul_exp_neg_sq_half_le t
  have e : -(1 / 2) * t ^ 2 = -t ^ 2 / 2 := by ring
  rw [e] at h2
  have h3 : 0 ≤ t * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2) := by positivity
  calc |hH 200 t| * t * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2) = |hH 200 t| * (t * Real.exp (-t ^ 2 / 2)) := by ring
    _ ≤ 3.15 * (1 / 1.625) := mul_le_mul h1 h2 h3 (by norm_num)
    _ ≤ 1.94 := by norm_num

theorem norm_trig_le (z : ℂ) (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) : ‖4 * z ^ 3 - 16 * z + 16‖ ≤ 31.4821 := by
  have hn : z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2 = 1 := by
    have := Complex.sq_norm z; rw [hz, Complex.normSq_apply] at this; nlinarith
  set x := z.re; set y := z.im
  have hz' : z = x + y * I := (Complex.re_add_im z).symm
  have hw : ‖4 * z ^ 3 - 16 * z + 16‖ ^ 2 = 512 * x ^ 3 - 256 * x ^ 2 - 896 * x + 656 := by
    rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply, hz']
    simp only [pow_succ, pow_zero, one_mul, mul_re, mul_im, add_re, add_im, sub_re, sub_im, ofReal_re,
      ofReal_im, I_re, I_im, re_ofNat, im_ofNat]
    have hy : y ^ 2 = 1 - x ^ 2 := by linarith
    have h4 : y ^ 4 = (1 - x ^ 2) ^ 2 := by rw [show y ^ 4 = (y ^ 2) ^ 2 by ring, hy]
    have h6 : y ^ 6 = (1 - x ^ 2) ^ 3 := by rw [show y ^ 6 = (y ^ 2) ^ 3 by ring, hy]
    ring_nf
    rw [h6, h4, hy]
    ring
  have hx1 : -1 ≤ x := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y]
  have hx2 : x ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y]
  have hP : 512 * x ^ 3 - 256 * x ^ 2 - 896 * x + 656 ≤ 991.1226 := by

    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab] at hx; exact ha.trans_le hx.1
  have d1 : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (1 / 4 : ℝ) (1 / 2),
      HasDerivAt (fun u => 4 * Real.log (4 * u)) (4 * x⁻¹) x := by
    intro x hx; have hx0 := pos (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hx
    have := (((hasDerivAt_id' x).const_mul 4).log (by positivity)).const_mul 4
    convert this using 1; field_simp
  have d1' : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (1 / 4 : ℝ) (1 / 2), HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => 4 * u⁻¹) (-4 * (x ^ 2)⁻¹) x := by
    intro x hx; have hx0 := pos (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hx
    convert (hasDerivAt_inv hx0.ne').const_mul 4 using 1; ring
  have d2 : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt (fun u => -4 * Real.log u) (-4 * x⁻¹) x := by
    intro x hx; have hx0 := pos (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hx

  have d2' : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1, HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => -4 * u⁻¹) (4 * (x ^ 2)⁻¹) x := by
    intro x hx; have hx0 := pos (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hx
    convert (hasDerivAt_inv hx0.ne').const_mul (-4) using 1; ring
  rw [fourier_eta2_eq, mul_add,
    ibp2 ht d1 d1' (continuousOn_inv_sq (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (-4)),

    rw [sq, ← e_add]; congr 1; ring
  have e4 : e (-(1 * t)) = z ^ 4 := by

  have htrig : ‖16 * e (-(1 / 2 * t)) - 16 * e (-(1 / 4 * t)) - 4 * e (-(1 * t))‖ ≤ 31.4821 := by

theorem eta2log_fourier_bound (t : ℝ) :
    (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖𝓕 (fun u => (eta2log ρ u : ℂ)) t‖ ≤ c₀ * Real.log ρ := by
  have h4 := ghat_eta2log (ρ := 4) le_rfl t
  have hρt := ghat_eta2log hρ t
  set A := eta2hat t
  set B := ghat (fun u => Real.log u * eta2 u) t
  have hA : (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖A‖ ≤ c₀ := eta2_fourier_bound' t
  have hk : ‖((2 * π * t) ^ 2 : ℂ)‖ = (2 * π * t) ^ 2 := by
    rw [show ((2 * π * t) ^ 2 : ℂ) = (((2 * π * t) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) by push_cast; ring,
      Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  have h48 : (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖B + (Real.log 4 : ℂ) * A‖ ≤ 48 * Real.log 2 := by
    have h := norm_eta2log4_le t
    have e : 𝓕 (fun u => ((Real.log (4 * u) * eta2 u : ℝ) : ℂ)) t = ghat (eta2log 4) t := rfl
    rw [e, h4, norm_mul, hk] at h
    exact h
  have hL : Real.log 4 ≤ Real.log ρ := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hρ
  have hL4 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]; norm_num
  have hl2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
  have hsplit : B + (Real.log ρ : ℂ) * A = (B + (Real.log 4 : ℂ) * A) +
      ((Real.log ρ - Real.log 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * A := by push_cast; ring
  have hn : ‖B + (Real.log ρ : ℂ) * A‖ ≤ ‖B + (Real.log 4 : ℂ) * A‖ +
      (Real.log ρ - Real.log 4) * ‖A‖ := by
    rw [hsplit]
    refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
  show (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖ghat (eta2log ρ) t‖ ≤ c₀ * Real.log ρ
  rw [hρt]
  have hk0 : 0 ≤ (2 * π * t) ^ 2 := by positivity
  calc (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖B + (Real.log ρ : ℂ) * A‖
      ≤ (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖B + (Real.log 4 : ℂ) * A‖ +
          (Real.log ρ - Real.log 4) * ((2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖A‖) := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn hk0; nlinarith
    _ ≤ 48 * Real.log 2 + (Real.log ρ - Real.log 4) * c₀ := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA (by linarith : 0 ≤ Real.log ρ - Real.log 4)
        linarith
    _ ≤ c₀ * Real.log ρ := by unfold c₀; nlinarith

theorem integral_abs_eta2 : ∫ t, |eta2 t| = 1 := by
  have habs : (fun t => |eta2 t|) = (Set.Icc (1 / 4 : ℝ) 1).indicator eta2 := by
    funext t
    by_cases ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 4 : ℝ) 1
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem ht, abs_of_nonneg (eta2_nonneg t)]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem ht, eta2_eq_zero (fun h => ht (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self h)),
        abs_zero]
  rw [habs, integral_indicator measurableSet_Icc, integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by norm_num)]
  have hii : ∀ a b, 1 / 4 ≤ a → b ≤ 1 → a ≤ b → IntervalIntegrable eta2 volume a b := by
    intro a b ha hb hab
    refine (continuousOn_eta2.mono ?_).intervalIntegrable
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab]; exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc ha hb
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (b := 1 / 2)
    (hii _ _ le_rfl (by norm_num) (by norm_num)) (hii _ _ (by norm_num) le_rfl (by norm_num))]
  have hL : ∫ t in (1 / 4 : ℝ)..1 / 2, eta2 t = 2 * Real.log 2 - 1 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun t => 4 * Real.log (4 * t)) fun t ht => by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num)] at ht; exact eta2_eq_left ht.1 ht.2]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,
      intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (fun t => Real.log t) (by norm_num : (4:ℝ) ≠ 0),
      integral_log]
    norm_num
    ring
  have hR : ∫ t in (1 / 2 : ℝ)..1, eta2 t = 2 - 2 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr (g := fun t => -4 * Real.log t) fun t ht => by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num)] at ht; exact eta2_eq_right ht.1 ht.2]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul,

    simp only [Real.log_one, one_div, Real.log_inv]
    ring
  rw [hL, hR]; ring

theorem ternaryGoldbachUpTo_1e27 : TernaryGoldbachUpTo (10 ^ 27) := by
  intro n hn h5 hle

  by_cases hsmall : n ≤ 4 * 10 ^ 18 + 3

    have hev : Even (n - 3) := Nat.Odd.sub_odd hn (by decide)
    obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpq⟩ := hBG (n - 3) hev (by obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hn; omega) (by omega)

  · -- a prime `p ∈ [n − 4·10¹⁸, n − 4]` from rung `i` of the ladder

    obtain ⟨p, hp, hp1, hp2⟩ := Ladder.ladder_prime hi1 hi2
    have hpb : p ≤ n - 4 := by omega
    have hpa : n - 4 * 10 ^ 18 ≤ p := by omega

    obtain ⟨q, r, hq, hr, hqr⟩ := hBG (n - p) hev (by omega) (by omega)

/-- Pairing ("majorization"): for convex `f` and `a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ d` with `b + c = a + d`,
`f b + f c ≤ f a + f d`. -/
theorem _root_.ConvexOn.add_le_add_of_majorize {s : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConvexOn ℝ s f)
    {a b c d : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ s) (hd : d ∈ s) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    (hsum : b + c = a + d) : f b + f c ≤ f a + f d := by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hab.trans (hbc.trans hcd)) with had | had
  · have : a = b := le_antisymm hab (by linarith)
    have : c = d := le_antisymm hcd (by linarith)
    subst_vars; rfl
  have hda : d - a ≠ 0 := (sub_pos.2 had).ne'
  have hc' : c = a + d - b := by linarith
  set l := (d - b) / (d - a)
  have hl0 : 0 ≤ l := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hl1 : l ≤ 1 := (div_le_one (by linarith)).2 (by linarith)
  have hb : l • a + (1 - l) • d = b := by
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, l]; field_simp; ring
  have hc : (1 - l) • a + l • d = c := by
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, l]; rw [hc']; field_simp; ring
  have h1 : f (l • a + (1 - l) • d) ≤ l • f a + (1 - l) • f d :=
    hf.2 ha hd hl0 (by linarith) (by ring)
  have h2 : f ((1 - l) • a + l • d) ≤ (1 - l) • f a + l • f d :=
    hf.2 ha hd (by linarith) hl0 (by ring)
  rw [hb] at h1; rw [hc] at h2
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h1 h2
  linarith

theorem _root_.ConvexOn.le_integral_of_midpoint {s : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConvexOn ℝ s f) {m : ℝ}
    (hs : Icc (m - 1 / 2) (m + 1 / 2) ⊆ s) (hc : ContinuousOn f (Icc (m - 1 / 2) (m + 1 / 2))) :
    f m ≤ ∫ x in (m - 1 / 2)..(m + 1 / 2), f x := by
  have hint : IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume (m - 1 / 2) (m + 1 / 2) :=
    hc.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by linarith)
  -- Reflection `x ↦ 2m - x` preserves the interval.
  have hrefl : ∫ x in (m - 1 / 2)..(m + 1 / 2), f (2 * m - x) = ∫ x in (m - 1 / 2)..(m + 1 / 2), f x := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left]; ring_nf
  have hint' : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f (2 * m - x)) MeasureTheory.volume
      (m - 1 / 2) (m + 1 / 2) := by
    refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by linarith) ?_
    refine hc.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).continuousOn fun x hx => ?_
    simp only [mem_Icc, id] at hx ⊢; constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2]
  have hpt : ∀ x ∈ Icc (m - 1 / 2) (m + 1 / 2), 2 * f m ≤ f x + f (2 * m - x) := by
    intro x hx

      (by norm_num)

    (hint.add hint') hpt

/-- **I2.** For unit-spaced points `u₁, u₁ + 1, …, u₁ + m - 1` in `[1, q/2]`,
`∑ min(A, C f_q(u)) ≤ (2q/π) √(AC)`. -/
theorem sum_G_le {q A C : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hC : 0 ≤ C) {u₁ : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    (hu₁ : 1 ≤ u₁) (hlast : u₁ + m - 1 ≤ q / 2) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, min A (C * fq q (u₁ + i)) ≤ 2 * (q / π) * √(A * C) := by
  set G := fun u => min A (C * fq q u)
  have hG0 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ G u := fun u => le_min hA (mul_nonneg hC (fq_nonneg q u))
  have hII : ∀ a b, IntervalIntegrable G volume a b := intervalIntegrable_G hA hC
  -- Each term is at most the integral over the unit interval to its left.
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range m,
      G (u₁ + i) ≤ ∫ u in (u₁ - 1 + i)..(u₁ - 1 + (i + 1 : ℕ)), G u := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' : (i : ℝ) + 1 ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast Finset.mem_range.1 hi
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by push_cast; linarith)]
    have hvol : volume.real (Ioc (u₁ - 1 + i) (u₁ - 1 + (i + 1 : ℕ))) = 1 := by
      rw [Real.volume_real_Ioc_of_le (by push_cast; linarith)]; push_cast; ring
    calc G (u₁ + i) = ∫ _ in Ioc (u₁ - 1 + i) (u₁ - 1 + (i + 1 : ℕ)), G (u₁ + i) := by
          rw [setIntegral_const, hvol, one_smul]
      _ ≤ _ := by
          refine setIntegral_mono_on continuous_const.integrableOn_Ioc ((hII _ _).1) measurableSet_Ioc
            fun v hv => ?_
          simp only [mem_Ioc] at hv; push_cast at hv
          exact min_le_min le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (fq_anti hq (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)) hC)
  have hsum := intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals (μ := volume) (f := G)
    (a := fun i : ℕ => u₁ - 1 + i) (n := m) fun i _ => hII _ _
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] at hsum
  -- Compare with `∫₀^{q/2} G`.
  have hsub : ∫ u in (u₁ - 1)..(u₁ - 1 + m), G u ≤ ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..(q / 2), G u := by
    have e1 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (a := 0) (b := u₁ - 1)
      (c := q / 2) (hII 0 (u₁ - 1)) (hII (u₁ - 1) (q / 2))
    have e2 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (a := u₁ - 1) (b := u₁ - 1 + m)
      (c := q / 2) (hII (u₁ - 1) (u₁ - 1 + m)) (hII (u₁ - 1 + m) (q / 2))
    have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := u₁ - 1)
      (by linarith) fun u _ => hG0 u
    have h2 := intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (μ := volume) (a := u₁ - 1 + m) (b := q / 2)
      (by linarith) fun u _ => hG0 u
    linarith
  -- Change of variables `v = πu/q`.
  have hcv : ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..(q / 2), G u =
      q / π * ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..(π / 2), min A (C * (1 / Real.sin v ^ 2)) := by
    have hpq : π / q ≠ 0 := (div_pos Real.pi_pos hq).ne'
    have : G = fun u => (fun v => min A (C * (1 / Real.sin v ^ 2))) ((π / q) * u) := by
      funext u; simp only [G, fq]; ring_nf
    rw [this, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left _ hpq, smul_eq_mul, inv_div]
    congr 2 <;> field_simp <;> simp
  calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, G (u₁ + i)
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, ∫ u in (u₁ - 1 + i)..(u₁ - 1 + (i + 1 : ℕ)), G u :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = ∫ u in (u₁ - 1)..(u₁ - 1 + m), G u := hsum
    _ ≤ ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..(q / 2), G u := hsub
    _ ≤ q / π * (2 * √(A * C)) := by
        rw [hcv]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (integral_minInvSin_le hA hC) (by positivity)
    _ = 2 * (q / π) * √(A * C) := by ring

def lemma_4_1_3 : Prop :=

    ∀ y₁ y₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ y₁ → y₁ < y₂ → y₂ - y₁ ≤ q → y₂ ≤ Q / 2 →
    ∀ B C : ℝ, 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ C →
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊y₁⌋ ⌊y₂⌋ with ¬ (q : ℤ) ∣ n,
          min (B / |Real.sin (π * α * n)|) (C / |Real.sin (π * α * n)| ^ 2)) ≤
        2 * B * (q / π) * max 2 (Real.log (C * Real.exp 3 * q / (B * π))) ∧
      (∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊y₁⌋ ⌊y₂⌋ with ¬ (q : ℤ) ∣ n,

are bounded by `Φ(sin²(π(R + τ_R)/q))` over distinct residues `R ∈ [1, q-1]`, `τ_R ∈ [0, 1/2]`. -/
theorem residue_form_gen {α Q : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (h : Approx α a q Q) {y₁ y₂ : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 ≤ y₁) (hlen : y₂ - y₁ ≤ q) (hy₂ : y₂ ≤ Q / 2) (Φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hΦ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Φ x) :
    ∃ τ : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ R, τ R ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) ∧
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊y₁⌋ ⌊y₂⌋,
          (if (q : ℤ) ∣ n then 0 else Φ (Real.sin (π * α * n) ^ 2)) ≤
        ∑ R ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (q - 1), Φ (Real.sin (π * (R + τ R) / q) ^ 2) := by
  obtain ⟨hq1, hcop, β, hβ, hα, hqQ⟩ := h
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  have hQ0 : 0 < Q := by linarith
  have hqz : (0 : ℤ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  set S := Finset.Ioc ⌊y₁⌋ ⌊y₂⌋
  set S' := S.filter fun n => ¬ (q : ℤ) ∣ n
  have hS : ∀ n ∈ S, 1 ≤ n ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ y₂ := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hn
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ⌊y₁⌋ := Int.floor_nonneg.2 hy
    exact ⟨by omega, (Int.cast_le.2 hn.2).trans (Int.floor_le y₂)⟩
  have hgap : ∀ n ∈ S, ∀ n' ∈ S, n - n' < q := by
    intro n hn n' hn'
    rw [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hn hn'
    have h1 : ((n - n' : ℤ) : ℝ) < q := by
      have a1 : (n : ℝ) ≤ y₂ := (Int.cast_le.2 hn.2).trans (Int.floor_le y₂)
      have a2 : y₁ < n' := by
        have := Int.lt_floor_add_one y₁
        have : ((⌊y₁⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ n' := by exact_mod_cast hn'.1
        linarith
      push_cast; linarith
    exact_mod_cast h1
  -- Orientation.
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hσβ⟩ : ∃ σ : ℤ, σ * σ = 1 ∧ 0 ≤ (σ : ℝ) * β := by
    rcases le_or_gt 0 β with h0 | h0
    · exact ⟨1, by norm_num, by simpa using h0⟩
    · exact ⟨-1, by norm_num, by push_cast; linarith⟩
  have hσr : (σ : ℝ) * σ = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hσ
  have hσabs : |(σ : ℝ)| = 1 := by
    have : |(σ : ℝ)| * |(σ : ℝ)| = 1 := by rw [← abs_mul, hσr, abs_one]
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (σ : ℝ)]
  set τ' := fun n : ℤ => (σ : ℝ) * β * n / Q
  have hτ' : ∀ n ∈ S, τ' n ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2) := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hS n hn
    have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : (0 : ℤ) ≤ n)
    have hσβ1 : (σ : ℝ) * β ≤ 1 := by
      calc (σ : ℝ) * β ≤ |(σ : ℝ) * β| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |β| := by rw [abs_mul, hσabs, one_mul]
        _ ≤ 1 := hβ
    simp only [τ', mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · positivity
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ hQ0]; nlinarith
  set m := fun n : ℤ => σ * (a * n)
  set R := fun n : ℤ => (m n % (q : ℤ)).toNat
  have hRcast : ∀ n, ((R n : ℕ) : ℤ) = m n % q := fun n =>
    Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg _ hqz.ne')
  have hRlt : ∀ n, R n < q := by
    intro n; simp only [R]
    have h1 := Int.emod_nonneg (m n) hqz.ne'
    have h2 := Int.emod_lt_of_pos (m n) hqz
    omega
  have hRpos : ∀ n ∈ S', 1 ≤ R n := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hn
    by_contra h0
    have h00 : m n % q = 0 := by have := hRcast n; omega
    apply hn.2
    have h1 : (q : ℤ) ∣ σ * (a * n) := Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero h00
    have h2 : (q : ℤ) ∣ σ * (σ * (a * n)) := dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h1 σ
    rw [← mul_assoc, hσ, one_mul] at h2
    exact hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h2
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℤ, Φ (Real.sin (π * α * n) ^ 2) = Φ (Real.sin (π * (R n + τ' n) / q) ^ 2) := by
    intro n
    congr 1
    have hm : a * n = σ * (q * (m n / q) + (R n : ℤ)) := by
      rw [hRcast, Int.mul_ediv_add_emod]; simp only [m]; rw [← mul_assoc, hσ, one_mul]
    have harg : π * α * n = (σ : ℝ) * (π * ((R n : ℝ) + τ' n) / q + ((m n / q : ℤ) : ℝ) * π) := by
      have e : π * α * n = π * (((a * n : ℤ) : ℝ) + β * n / Q) / q := by
        rw [hα]; push_cast; field_simp
      rw [e, hm]; push_cast; simp only [τ']; field_simp; ring_nf
      rw [show (σ : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1 by rw [sq, hσr]]; ring
    rw [harg]
    rcases Int.eq_one_or_neg_one_of_mul_eq_one hσ with hs | hs <;>
    · subst hs; push_cast
      simp only [one_mul, neg_one_mul, Real.sin_neg, neg_sq]
      rw [sin_sq_add_int_mul_pi]
  have hinj : Set.InjOn R S' := by
    intro n hn n' hn' hR
    have hn1 := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hn).1
    have hn1' := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hn').1
    have hmod : m n % q = m n' % q := by rw [← hRcast, ← hRcast]; exact congrArg _ hR
    have hdvd : (q : ℤ) ∣ a * (n - n') := by
      have h1 : (q : ℤ) ∣ m n - m n' := Int.ModEq.dvd hmod.symm
      have : m n - m n' = σ * (a * (n - n')) := by simp only [m]; ring
      rw [this] at h1
      have h2 : (q : ℤ) ∣ σ * (σ * (a * (n - n'))) := dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h1 σ
      rwa [← mul_assoc, hσ, one_mul] at h2
    have hd : (q : ℤ) ∣ n - n' := hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hdvd
    have g1 := hgap n hn1 n' hn1'
    have g2 := hgap n' hn1' n hn1
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hd
    have : t = 0 := by
      by_contra ht0
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ht0 with h | h
      · have : (q : ℤ) * t ≤ -q := by nlinarith
        omega
      · have : (q : ℤ) ≤ q * t := by nlinarith
        omega
    subst this; omega
  set τR := fun r : ℕ => if hr : ∃ n ∈ S', R n = r then τ' hr.choose else 0
  have hτR : ∀ n ∈ S', τR (R n) = τ' n := by
    intro n hn
    have hex : ∃ n' ∈ S', R n' = R n := ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    simp only [τR, dite_eq_left hex]
    have := hex.choose_spec
    rw [hinj this.1 hn this.2]
  refine ⟨τR, fun r => ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [τR]
    split_ifs with hr
    · exact hτ' _ (Finset.mem_filter.1 hr.choose_spec.1).1
    · exact ⟨le_rfl, by norm_num⟩
  · set g := fun r : ℕ => Φ (Real.sin (π * (r + τR r) / q) ^ 2)
    have hg0 : ∀ r, 0 ≤ g r := fun r => hΦ _
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter_not_add_sum_filter S (fun n => (q : ℤ) ∣ n)]
    have hzero : ∑ n ∈ S.filter (fun n => (q : ℤ) ∣ n),
        (if (q : ℤ) ∣ n then 0 else Φ (Real.sin (π * α * n) ^ 2)) = 0 :=
      Finset.sum_eq_zero fun n hn => by rw [ite_eq_left (Finset.mem_filter.1 hn).2]
    rw [hzero, add_zero]
    have hS'eq : ∑ n ∈ S', (if (q : ℤ) ∣ n then 0 else Φ (Real.sin (π * α * n) ^ 2)) =
        ∑ n ∈ S', g (R n) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
      rw [ite_eq_right (Finset.mem_filter.1 hn).2, hterm n]
      simp only [g, hτR n hn]
    rw [hS'eq, ← Finset.sum_image (fun n hn n' hn' h => hinj hn hn' h)]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ fun r _ _ => hg0 r
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hr
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc]
    exact ⟨hRpos n hn, by have := hRlt n; omega⟩

theorem second_approx {ξ Q ε : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ))
    (hqQ : (q : ℝ) ≤ Q) (hε : 0 < ε) (hexact : |ξ - a / q| = 1 / (q * Q)) :
    ∃ (a' : ℤ) (q' : ℕ), 1 ≤ q' ∧ IsCoprime a' (q' : ℤ) ∧ (q' : ℝ) ≤ (1 + ε) * Q ∧
      |ξ - a' / q'| ≤ 1 / (q' * ((1 + ε) * Q)) ∧ ε * Q / (1 + ε) ≤ q' := by
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hQ1 : 1 ≤ Q := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hq) hqQ
  have hQ0 : 0 < Q := by linarith
  set Q' := (1 + ε) * Q
  have hQ'1 : 1 ≤ Q' := by simp only [Q']; nlinarith
  set n := ⌊Q'⌋₊
  have hn : 0 < n := Nat.floor_pos.2 hQ'1
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrden⟩ := Real.exists_rat_abs_sub_le_and_den_le ξ hn
  set a' := r.num
  set q' := r.den
  have hq'1 : 1 ≤ q' := r.den_pos
  have hq'0 : (0 : ℝ) < q' := by exact_mod_cast hq'1
  have hcast : (r : ℝ) = a' / q' := Rat.cast_def r
  have hcop' : IsCoprime a' (q' : ℤ) := by
    rw [Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one]; exact r.reduced
  have hq'Q' : (q' : ℝ) ≤ Q' := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hrden) (Nat.floor_le (by linarith))
  have hnQ' : Q' < n + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one Q'
  have happ : |ξ - a' / q'| ≤ 1 / (q' * Q') := by
    rw [← hcast]
    refine hr.trans ?_
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
    rw [mul_comm (q' : ℝ)]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnQ'.le hq'0.le
  refine ⟨a', q', hq'1, hcop', hq'Q', happ, ?_⟩

      (if Odd m ∧ ((q : ℕ) ∣ m ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ M) then (μ m : ℂ) * Todd α x m else 0) +
      (if Odd m ∧ ¬ ((q : ℕ) ∣ m ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ M) then (μ m : ℂ) * Todd α x m else 0) := by
    intro m _
    by_cases h1 : Odd m <;> by_cases h2 : ((q : ℕ) ∣ m ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ M) <;> simp [h1, h2]
  rw [sum_congr rfl hsplit, sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  rw [← sum_filter, ← sum_filter]
  refine (sum_nbij' (fun m => m / q) (fun m' => q * m') ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_)
  · intro m hm
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_Icc] at hm
    obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, hodd, ⟨t, rfl⟩, hle⟩ := hm
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_Icc]
    have ht : q * t / q = t := Nat.mul_div_cancel_left t (by omega)
    rw [ht]
    have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t with h | h

      · exact h

    rw [le_div_iff₀ hq0]; push_cast at hle ⊢; linarith
  · intro m' hm'

theorem pair_le_half {n r : ℝ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hr : |r| ≤ 1 / 2) :

    have := sq_abs r ▸ pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg r) hr 2; linarith
  have h1 : 0 < n - r := by linarith [neg_abs_le r, le_abs_self r]
  have h2 : 0 < n + r := by linarith [neg_abs_le r, le_abs_self r]
  have h3 : 0 < n - 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have h4 : 0 < n + 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have E : ∀ t, 0 < n - t → 0 < n + t →
      1 / (n - t) ^ 2 + 1 / (n + t) ^ 2 = 2 * (n ^ 2 + t ^ 2) / (n ^ 2 - t ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    intro t ht1 ht2
    have : n ^ 2 - t ^ 2 = (n - t) * (n + t) := by ring
    rw [this]; field_simp; ring
  have e1 := E r h1 h2
  have e2 := E (1 / 2) h3 h4
  rw [show ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 = 1 / 4 by norm_num] at e2
  rw [e1, e2]
  have ha : 0 < n ^ 2 - r ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hb : 0 < n ^ 2 - 1 / 4 := by nlinarith
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
  -- `(N+a)(N-b)² ≤ (N+b)(N-a)²` with `a = r² ≤ b = 1/4`, `N = n² ≥ 1`.

      (1 / 4 - r ^ 2) * (3 * (n ^ 2) ^ 2 - n ^ 2 * (r ^ 2 + 1 / 4) - r ^ 2 / 4) := by ring
  have : 0 ≤ (1 / 4 - r ^ 2) * (3 * (n ^ 2) ^ 2 - n ^ 2 * (r ^ 2 + 1 / 4) - r ^ 2 / 4) := by
    apply mul_nonneg (by linarith); nlinarith [sq_nonneg r]
  nlinarith

      (if Odd m ∧ ((q : ℕ) ∣ m ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ M) then (μ m : ℂ) * Todd α x m else 0) +
      (if Odd m ∧ ¬ ((q : ℕ) ∣ m ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ M) then (μ m : ℂ) * Todd α x m else 0) := by
    intro m _
    by_cases h1 : Odd m <;> by_cases h2 : ((q : ℕ) ∣ m ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ M) <;> simp [h1, h2]

  congr 1
  rw [← sum_filter, ← sum_filter]

  · intro m hm
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_Icc] at hm
    obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, hodd, ⟨t, rfl⟩, hle⟩ := hm
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_Icc]
    have ht : q * t / q = t := Nat.mul_div_cancel_left t (by omega)
    rw [ht]
    have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := by

    refine ⟨⟨ht1, ?_⟩, hodd⟩
    apply Nat.le_floor

  · intro m hm

theorem norm_Todd_le (α : ℝ) :
    ‖Todd α x m‖ ≤ x / (2 * m) + eta2'L1 / 2 ∧
    (Real.sin (2 * π * m * α) ≠ 0 →
      ‖Todd α x m‖ ≤ eta2'L1 / 2 / |Real.sin (2 * π * m * α)| ∧
      ‖Todd α x m‖ ≤ m / x * (c₀ / 2) / Real.sin (2 * π * m * α) ^ 2) := by
  have hsin : π * (2 * α * m) = 2 * π * m * α := by ring
  rw [Todd_eq, norm_mul, norm_e, one_mul]
  refine ⟨?_, fun hs => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨hsumm, hle⟩ := tsum_norm_le_variation (continuous_fodd)
      (hasCompactSupport_fodd hx hm) eta2'L1_pos.le (variation_fodd hx hm)
    rw [integral_norm_fodd hx hm] at hle
    refine le_trans ?_ hle
    refine (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm ?_).trans (le_of_eq (tsum_congr fun r => ?_))
    · exact hsumm.congr fun r => by rw [norm_mul, norm_e, mul_one]
    · rw [norm_mul, norm_e, mul_one]
  · have := norm_tsum_le_variation (hasCompactSupport_fodd hx hm) eta2'L1_pos.le
      (variation_fodd hx hm) (α := 2 * α * m) (by rwa [hsin])
    rw [hsin] at this
    refine this.trans (le_of_eq ?_); ring
  · have := norm_tsum_le_of_fourier_bound (continuous_fodd) (hasCompactSupport_fodd hx hm)
      (fourier_bound_fodd hx hm) (α := 2 * α * m) (by rwa [hsin])
    rw [hsin] at this
    refine this.trans (le_of_eq ?_); ring

theorem norm_Todd_le_min_sin {α x δ : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (h2α : 2 * α = a / q + δ / x + k) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (hne : Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * (m : ℤ)) ≠ 0) {A B C : ℝ}
    (hA : x / (2 * m) + eta2'L1 / 2 ≤ A) (hB : eta2'L1 / 2 ≤ B) (hC : m / x * (c₀ / 2) ≤ C) :
    ‖Todd α x m‖ ≤ min A (C / Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * (m : ℤ)) ^ 2) ∧
    ‖Todd α x m‖ ≤ min (B / |Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * (m : ℤ))|)
      (C / Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * (m : ℤ)) ^ 2) := by
  have hs := sin_sq_two_pi_mul h2α (m : ℝ) ⟨m, by simp⟩
  push_cast at hs hne ⊢
  have habs : |Real.sin (2 * π * m * α)| = |Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * m)| := by
    rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _), sq_abs, sq_abs, hs]

    intro h; apply hne; rw [← abs_eq_zero, ← habs, h, abs_zero]
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := norm_Todd_le hx hm α
  obtain ⟨h2a, h2b⟩ := h2 hne'
  have hC' : ‖Todd α x m‖ ≤ C / Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * m) ^ 2 := by
    refine h2b.trans ?_; rw [hs]; exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hC (sq_nonneg _)

  refine h2a.trans ?_; rw [habs]; exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hB (abs_nonneg _)

theorem sum_Ioc_le_blocks {G : ℤ → ℝ} (hG : ∀ n, 0 ≤ G n) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ∀ (J : ℕ) (a b : ℝ), b ≤ a + J * q →
      ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, G n ≤
        ∑ j ∈ range J, ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a + j * q⌋ ⌊min (a + (j + 1) * q) b⌋, G n := by
  intro J
  induction J with
  | zero =>
    intro a b hab
    simp only [CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] at hab
    rw [Ioc_eq_empty (not_lt.2 (Int.floor_mono hab))]; simp
  | succ J ih =>
    intro a b hab
    rw [sum_range_succ']
    simp only [CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add, one_mul]
    have hq' : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
    have hih := ih (a + q) b (by push_cast at hab; linarith)
    have hrw : ∀ j : ℕ, a + q + j * q = a + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * q := fun j => by push_cast; ring
    have hrw2 : ∀ j : ℕ, a + q + (j + 1) * q = a + (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * q := fun j => by
      push_cast; ring
    simp_rw [hrw, hrw2] at hih
    rcases le_or_gt b (a + q) with hb | hb
    · rw [min_eq_right hb]
      have : ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a + q⌋ ⌊b⌋, G n = 0 := by
        rw [Ioc_eq_empty (not_lt.2 (Int.floor_mono hb))]; simp
      have h0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ range J, ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * q⌋
          ⌊min (a + (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * q) b⌋, G n :=
        sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sum_nonneg fun _ _ => hG _

theorem e_phase {α x δ : ℝ} {a k₀ : ℤ} {q m' : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hm' : Odd m')

  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hm'
  have hq0 : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
    linarith
  have hα : α = (a / q + δ / x + k₀) / 2 := by linarith
  have : α * ((q * (2 * j + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * r + 1) =
      (a + k₀ * q) / 2 + δ * ((q * (2 * j + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * x) * (2 * r + 1) +
        (((a + k₀ * q) * (2 * j * r + j + r) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [hα]; push_cast; field_simp; ring
  rw [this, e_add, e_add, e_intCast, mul_one]

    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
    linarith
  have hα : α = (a / q + δ / x + k₀) / 2 := by linarith
  have : α * ((q * (2 * j + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * r + 1) =

/-- [H, (4.36)] in the form used with Lemma 4.1.1: `|T_{m,∘}| ≤ minA(x/2m + |η'|₁/2, (m/x)(c₀/2), sin²)`. -/
theorem norm_Todd_le_minA {α x δ : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (h2α : 2 * α = a / q + δ / x + k) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {A C : ℝ}
    (hA : x / (2 * m) + eta2'L1 / 2 ≤ A) (hC : m / x * (c₀ / 2) ≤ C) :
    ‖Todd α x m‖ ≤ minA A C (Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * (m : ℤ)) ^ 2) := by
  have hs := sin_sq_two_pi_mul h2α (m : ℝ) ⟨m, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := norm_Todd_le hx hm α
  push_cast at hs ⊢
  unfold minA
  split_ifs with h0
  · exact h1.trans hA
  · have hne : Real.sin (2 * π * m * α) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; apply h0; rw [← hs, h]; ring
    refine le_min (h1.trans hA) ?_
    refine (h2 hne).2.trans ?_
    rw [hs]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hC (sq_nonneg _)

noncomputable def c₂ : ℝ := 6 * π / (5 * √c₀)

/-- [H, (4.37)]: `5c₀c₂/(3π²) = 2√c₀/π`. -/
theorem c₂_identity : 5 * c₀ * c₂ / (3 * π ^ 2) = 2 * √c₀ / π := by
  have h := c₀_pos
  have hs : √c₀ * √c₀ = c₀ := Real.mul_self_sqrt h.le
  have hs0 : 0 < √c₀ := Real.sqrt_pos.2 h

/-- **[H, Lemma B.2.3, (B.11)]**: `|η̂_(ρ)''|_∞ ≤ 31.521 log ρ` for `ρ ≥ 4`, written as
`(2πt)² |η̂_(ρ)(t)| ≤ c₀ log ρ`. By `ghat_eta2log`, `η̂_(ρ) = (log·η₂)^ + log ρ · η̂₂`. For `ρ = 4`,

theorem eta2log_fourier_bound (t : ℝ) :
    (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖𝓕 (fun u => (eta2log ρ u : ℂ)) t‖ ≤ c₀ * Real.log ρ := by
  have h4 := ghat_eta2log (ρ := 4) le_rfl t
  have hρt := ghat_eta2log hρ t
  set A := eta2hat t
  set B := ghat (fun u => Real.log u * eta2 u) t
  have hA : (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖A‖ ≤ c₀ := eta2_fourier_bound' t
  have hk : ‖((2 * π * t) ^ 2 : ℂ)‖ = (2 * π * t) ^ 2 := by
    rw [show ((2 * π * t) ^ 2 : ℂ) = (((2 * π * t) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) by push_cast; ring,
      Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  have h48 : (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖B + (Real.log 4 : ℂ) * A‖ ≤ 48 * Real.log 2 := by
    have h := norm_eta2log4_le t
    have e : 𝓕 (fun u => ((Real.log (4 * u) * eta2 u : ℝ) : ℂ)) t = ghat (eta2log 4) t := rfl
    rw [e, h4, norm_mul, hk] at h
    exact h
  have hL : Real.log 4 ≤ Real.log ρ := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hρ
  have hL4 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]; norm_num
  have hl2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
  have hsplit : B + (Real.log ρ : ℂ) * A = (B + (Real.log 4 : ℂ) * A) +
      ((Real.log ρ - Real.log 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * A := by push_cast; ring
  have hn : ‖B + (Real.log ρ : ℂ) * A‖ ≤ ‖B + (Real.log 4 : ℂ) * A‖ +
      (Real.log ρ - Real.log 4) * ‖A‖ := by
    rw [hsplit]
    refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
  show (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖ghat (eta2log ρ) t‖ ≤ c₀ * Real.log ρ
  rw [hρt]
  have hk0 : 0 ≤ (2 * π * t) ^ 2 := by positivity
  calc (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖B + (Real.log ρ : ℂ) * A‖
      ≤ (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖B + (Real.log 4 : ℂ) * A‖ +
          (Real.log ρ - Real.log 4) * ((2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖A‖) := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn hk0; nlinarith
    _ ≤ 48 * Real.log 2 + (Real.log ρ - Real.log 4) * c₀ := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA (by linarith : 0 ≤ Real.log ρ - Real.log 4)
        linarith
    _ ≤ c₀ * Real.log ρ := by unfold c₀; nlinarith

    ∑ m' ∈ Icc 1 N, (if Odd m' then ((q : ℝ) * m') * (Real.log x - Real.log (q * m')) else 0) ≤

  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have he : x / rexp 1 ≤ x := div_le_self hx.le (by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1:ℝ)])
  have hRHS1 : 0 ≤ M * (Real.log x - Real.log M) :=

  set I := (N + 1) / 2
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos I with hI | hI
  · rw [hI, sum_range_zero]; linarith
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K, I = K + 1 := ⟨I - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [hK, sum_range_succ]
  set t : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => (q : ℝ) * ((2 * i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)

    ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hq0 hs.1, hs.2.trans (by rw [← ht]; exact htKx)⟩
  have hMono := sum_le_of_monotone (F := fun s => s ^ 2 / 2 * (1 / 2 + Real.log x - Real.log s))
    (f := fun s => s * (Real.log x - Real.log s)) (a := q) (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * q) K
    (fun s hs => hasDerivAt_F₂ x (lt_of_lt_of_le hq0 hs.1)) ((monotoneOn_f₂ x hx).mono hsub)
  have key : ∀ i : ℕ, (q : ℝ) + i * (2 * q) = t i := fun i => (ht i).symm

      have h2 : t 0 = q := by simp [t]

    linarith [Real.log_le_log hq0 this]
  have hlast : t K * (Real.log x - Real.log (t K)) ≤ M * (Real.log x - Real.log M) :=

  have hρ : 4 ≤ x / m := by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]; linarith

noncomputable def mainPartI2 (α x M U V : ℝ) (q : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 ⌊M⌋₊, if Odd a ∧ q ∣ a then (coefI2 U V a : ℂ) * Todd α x a else 0

proof_context.conclusion: For even `q` no odd `a` is divisible by `q`, so `mainPartI2 = 0` and the bound holds trivially.

rcases Nat.even_or_odd q with hqe | hqo

      exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 ho) ((even_iff_two_dvd.2 (even_iff_two_dvd.1 hqe)).trans_dvd hd |>
        fun h => h)
    rw [this, norm_zero]; exact hRHS

proof_context.conclusion: For odd `a`, `q ∣ a`, `a ≤ ⌊M⌋`, `Todd α x a = e(..)(x/(2a) * eta2hat(-δ/2) + E)` with `‖E‖ ≤ a/x * c₀/(2π²) * (π²-4)` (Todd_main), so `mainPartI2 = κ (x/2 * η0 * Σ c(a)/a + Σ c(a) E(a))`; this is the analogue of (4.50)'s expansion for `η₂`.

have hT : ∀ a : ℕ, ∃ E : ℂ, Odd a → q ∣ a → 1 ≤ a → a ≤ NM →
      Todd α x a = e ((a₀ + k * q) / 2) * ((x / (2 * a) : ℝ) * eta2hat (-(δ / 2)) + E) ∧
      ‖E‖ ≤ a / x * (c₀ / (2 * π ^ 2)) * (π ^ 2 - 4) := by
    intro a
    by_cases h : Odd a ∧ q ∣ a ∧ 1 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ NM
    · obtain ⟨ho, ⟨m', rfl⟩, h1, hle⟩ := h
      have hm'o : Odd m' := (Nat.odd_mul.1 ho).2
      have hr : |δ * (q * m' : ℕ) / x| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
        have hqm : ((q * m' : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ M := (by exact_mod_cast hle : ((q * m' : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ NM).trans hNM
        rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hx, Nat.abs_cast, div_le_iff₀ hx]
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg δ]
      obtain ⟨E, hE1, hE2⟩ := Todd_main hx hq hm'o h2α hr
      exact ⟨E, fun _ _ _ _ => ⟨hE1, hE2⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h1 h2 h3 h4 => absurd ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ h⟩
  choose E hE using hT
  set κ := e ((a₀ + k * q) / 2)
  set η0 := eta2hat (-(δ / 2))
  have hsplit : mainPartI2 α x M U V q = κ * (((x / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * η0 *
        ((∑ a ∈ Icc 1 NM, (if Odd a ∧ q ∣ a then coefI2 U V a * (1 / a) else 0) : ℝ) : ℂ) +
      ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 NM, (if Odd a ∧ q ∣ a then (coefI2 U V a : ℂ) * E a else 0)) := by
    rw [mainPartI2, Complex.ofReal_sum, mul_sum, ← sum_add_distrib, mul_sum]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
    have ha1 : 1 ≤ a := (mem_Icc.1 ha).1
    have haN : a ≤ NM := (mem_Icc.1 ha).2
    by_cases h : Odd a ∧ q ∣ a
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h, if_pos h, (hE a h.1 h.2 ha1 haN).1]
      have ha0 : (0 : ℝ) < a := by exact_mod_cast ha1
      push_cast; field_simp
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, if_neg h]; simp

/-- `∑_{a ≤ N} [P a] c(a) f(a) = ∑_{v ≤ V, u ≤ U} [P(vu)] Λ(v) μ(u) f(vu)` for `N ≥ ⌊V⌋⌊U⌋`. -/
theorem sum_coefI2_eq {U V : ℝ} (hU : 0 ≤ U) (hV : 0 ≤ V) (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (f : ℕ → ℝ) {N : ℕ} (hN : ⌊V⌋₊ * ⌊U⌋₊ ≤ N) :
    ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 N, (if P a then coefI2 U V a * f a else 0) =
      ∑ p ∈ Icc 1 ⌊V⌋₊ ×ˢ Icc 1 ⌊U⌋₊,
        (if P (p.1 * p.2) then (Λ p.1 : ℝ) * (μ p.2 : ℝ) * f (p.1 * p.2) else 0) := by
  rw [sum_pairs_eq_sum_divisors hU hV (fun v u =>
    if P (v * u) then (Λ v : ℝ) * (μ u : ℝ) * f (v * u) else 0)]
  have hsub : Icc 1 (⌊V⌋₊ * ⌊U⌋₊) ⊆ Icc 1 N := Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hN
  rw [← sum_subset hsub (fun a ha hna => by
    rw [coefI2_eq_zero_of_gt hU hV (by simp only [mem_Icc] at ha hna; omega)]; simp)]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  rw [coefI2]
  split_ifs with hP
  · rw [sum_mul]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun v hv => ?_
    have hva : v * (a / v) = a := Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.mem_divisors.1 hv).1
    rw [hva, if_pos hP]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  · refine (sum_eq_zero fun v hv => ?_).symm
    have hva : v * (a / v) = a := Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.mem_divisors.1 hv).1
    rw [hva, if_neg hP]; split_ifs <;> rfl

/-- `q | vu ⟺ q/gcd(q,v) | u`. -/
theorem dvd_mul_iff_div_gcd {q v u : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    q ∣ v * u ↔ q / Nat.gcd q v ∣ u := by
  have hg : 0 < Nat.gcd q v := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left v hq
  set g := Nat.gcd q v with hgdef
  obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁⟩ := Nat.gcd_dvd_left q v
  obtain ⟨v₁, hv₁⟩ := Nat.gcd_dvd_right q v
  have hq1eq : q / g = q₁ := by
    have : q / g = g * q₁ / g := congrArg (· / g) hq₁
    rw [this, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg]
  have hv1eq : v / g = v₁ := by
    have : v / g = g * v₁ / g := congrArg (· / g) hv₁
    rw [this, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg]
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime q₁ v₁ := by
    have := Nat.coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd (m := q) (n := v) hg
    rwa [← hgdef, hq1eq, hv1eq] at this
  rw [hq1eq]
  have e : (q ∣ v * u) = (g * q₁ ∣ g * (v₁ * u)) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← hq₁, ← hv₁]
  rw [e]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left hg h)
  · intro h
    exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left _ (Dvd.dvd.mul_left h _)

proof_context.conclusion: For each odd `v`, the `u`-sum is `Λ(v)/v * Σ_{u ≤ min(NU,NM/v), u odd, q' ∣ u} μ(u)/u` with `q' = q/gcd(q,v)` odd, bounded by `Λ(v)/v * 1/q'` via `abs_sum_moebius_odd_dvd_le`; even `v` contribute 0.

      (Λ v : ℝ) * Nat.gcd q v / v * (1 / q) := by
    intro v hv
    have hv1 : 1 ≤ v := (mem_Icc.1 hv).1
    have hv0 : (0 : ℝ) < v := by exact_mod_cast hv1
    have hΛ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (n := v)
    have hgpos : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.gcd q v := by exact_mod_cast Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left v (by omega)
    have hRHS : 0 ≤ (Λ v : ℝ) * Nat.gcd q v / v * (1 / q) := by positivity
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd v with hve | hvo
    · rw [sum_eq_zero fun u _ => by
        rw [if_neg]; rintro ⟨⟨ho, _⟩, _⟩
        exact (Nat.not_odd_iff_even.2 (hve.mul_right u)) ho]
      simpa using hRHS
    set q' := q / Nat.gcd q v
    have hq'odd : Odd q' := Odd.of_dvd_nat hq (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd (Nat.gcd_dvd_left q v))
    have hq'eq : (q' : ℝ) = q / Nat.gcd q v := by
      simp only [q']; rw [Nat.cast_div (Nat.gcd_dvd_left q v) hgpos.ne']
    -- Rewrite the `u`-sum.
    have hrw : ∑ u ∈ Icc 1 NU, (if (Odd (v * u) ∧ q ∣ v * u) ∧ v * u ≤ NM then
        (Λ v : ℝ) * (μ u : ℝ) * (1 / ((v * u : ℕ) : ℝ)) else 0) =
        (Λ v : ℝ) / v * ∑ u ∈ Icc 1 (min NU (NM / v)),
          (if Odd u ∧ q' ∣ u then (μ u : ℝ) / u else 0) := by
      rw [mul_sum]
      rw [← sum_subset (Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl (min_le_left _ _) : Icc 1 (min NU (NM / v)) ⊆ Icc 1 NU)
        (fun u hu hnu => by
          rw [if_neg]
          rintro ⟨_, hle⟩
          simp only [mem_Icc] at hu hnu
          have : u ≤ NM / v := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hv1).2 (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hle)
          omega)]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun u hu => ?_
      have hule : u ≤ NM / v := (mem_Icc.1 hu).2.trans (min_le_right _ _)
      have hvu : v * u ≤ NM := by
        have := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hv1).1 hule; rw [mul_comm]; exact this
      have hodd : Odd (v * u) ↔ Odd u := by
        rw [Nat.odd_mul]; exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hvo, h⟩⟩
      have hdvd := dvd_mul_iff_div_gcd (q := q) (v := v) (u := u) (by omega)
      by_cases h : Odd u ∧ q' ∣ u
      · rw [if_pos ⟨⟨hodd.2 h.1, hdvd.2 h.2⟩, hvu⟩, if_pos h]
        have hu0 : (0 : ℝ) < u := by exact_mod_cast (mem_Icc.1 hu).1
        push_cast; field_simp
      · rw [if_neg (fun h' => h ⟨hodd.1 h'.1.1, hdvd.1 h'.1.2⟩), if_neg h, mul_zero]
    rw [hrw, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    have hA := abs_sum_moebius_odd_dvd_le hq'odd ((min NU (NM / v) : ℕ) : ℝ) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    rw [Nat.floor_natCast] at hA
    calc (Λ v : ℝ) / v * |∑ u ∈ Icc 1 (min NU (NM / v)), (if Odd u ∧ q' ∣ u then (μ u : ℝ) / u else 0)|
        ≤ (Λ v : ℝ) / v * (1 / q') := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by rw [hq'eq]; field_simp

/-- [H, p. 72]: for `q'` odd, `|∑_{u ≤ R, u odd, q' | u} μ(u)/u| ≤ 1/q'` (by (2.20)). -/
theorem abs_sum_moebius_odd_dvd_le {q' : ℕ} (hq' : Odd q') (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    |∑ u ∈ Icc 1 ⌊R⌋₊, (if Odd u ∧ q' ∣ u then (μ u : ℝ) / u else 0)| ≤ 1 / q' := by
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q' := hq'.pos
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q' := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  rw [sum_dvd_reindex hq1 R hR]
  have hodd : ∀ w, Odd (q' * w) ↔ Odd w := fun w => by
    rw [Nat.odd_mul]; exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hq', h⟩⟩
  have hterm : ∀ w ∈ Icc 1 ⌊R / q'⌋₊, (if Odd (q' * w) then (μ (q' * w) : ℝ) / ((q' * w : ℕ) : ℝ) else 0) =
      (1 / q') * ((μ q' : ℝ) * (if Nat.Coprime w (2 * q') then (μ w : ℝ) / w * 1 else 0)) := by
    intro w hw
    have hw1 : (0 : ℝ) < w := by exact_mod_cast (mem_Icc.1 hw).1
    rw [← moebius_odd_term hq' w]
    by_cases ho : Odd w
    · rw [if_pos ((hodd w).2 ho), if_pos ho]; push_cast; field_simp

/-- **[H, (2.20)]** (Granville–Ramaré [GR96, Lemma 10.2]):
`|∑_{n ≤ x, (n, q) = 1} μ(n)/n| ≤ 1` for all `x` and all `q ≥ 1`. -/
theorem abs_sum_moebius_div_coprime_le_one (x : ℝ) {q : ℕ} (_hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    |∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, (if Nat.Coprime n q then (μ n : ℝ) / n else 0)| ≤ 1 := by
  set N := ⌊x⌋₊
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with hN | hN
  · simp [hN]
  have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hIcc : Icc 1 N = Ioc 0 N := Finset.Icc_succ_left_eq_Ioc 0 N
  -- `fr n = N/n - ⌊N/n⌋`.
  set fr : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (N : ℝ) / n - ((N / n : ℕ) : ℝ) with hfr
  have hfr_bd : ∀ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, 0 ≤ fr n ∧ fr n < 1 := by
    intro n hn
    have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (mem_Ioc.1 hn).1
    have hdm := Nat.div_add_mod N n
    have hmod := Nat.mod_lt N (mem_Ioc.1 hn).1
    have hN' : (N : ℝ) = n * ((N / n : ℕ) : ℝ) + ((N % n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdm.symm
    have hmod' : ((N % n : ℕ) : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hmod
    have : fr n = ((N % n : ℕ) : ℝ) / n := by
      simp only [hfr]; rw [hN']; field_simp; ring
    rw [this]
    exact ⟨by positivity, (div_lt_one hn0).2 hmod'⟩
  have hfr1 : fr 1 = 0 := by simp [hfr]
  -- The identity `∑ g = ∑ f ⌊N/n⌋`.
  have hid : ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, (gCop q n : ℝ) = ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, (muCop q n : ℝ) * ((N / n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have := ArithmeticFunction.sum_Ioc_mul_zeta_eq_sum (muCop q) N
    rw [← gCop] at this
    have h := congrArg (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ) this
    push_cast at h
    exact h
  -- `N · S = ∑ (g n + f n · fr n)`.
  have hS : (N : ℝ) * ∑ n ∈ Icc 1 N, (if Nat.Coprime n q then (μ n : ℝ) / n else 0) =
      ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, ((gCop q n : ℝ) + (muCop q n : ℝ) * fr n) := by
    rw [sum_add_distrib, hid, ← sum_add_distrib, hIcc, mul_sum]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
    have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (mem_Ioc.1 hn).1.ne'
    simp only [hfr, muCop_apply]
    split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> field_simp <;> ring
  -- Each term is in `[-1, 1]`.
  have hterm : ∀ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, |(gCop q n : ℝ) + (muCop q n : ℝ) * fr n| ≤ 1 := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hfr_bd n hn
    by_cases hc : n.Coprime q
    · by_cases hn1 : n = 1
      · subst hn1; rw [hfr1]; simp [(isMultiplicative_gCop q).map_one]
      · rw [gCop_of_coprime hc, if_neg hn1, muCop_apply, if_pos hc]
        have hμ : |(μ n : ℝ)| ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_le_one
        push_cast
        rw [zero_add, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h0]
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (μ n : ℝ)]
    · rw [muCop_apply, if_neg hc]
      rcases gCop_zero_or_one q n with h | h <;> simp [h]
  have hbound : |(N : ℝ) * ∑ n ∈ Icc 1 N, (if Nat.Coprime n q then (μ n : ℝ) / n else 0)| ≤ N := by
    rw [hS]
    refine (abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
    refine (sum_le_sum hterm).trans ?_
    simp
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hNr] at hbound
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by linarith) hNr

/-- **[H, p. 72]**: `|∑_{a ≤ M, a odd, q | a} c(a)/a| ≤ (log q + log V)/q` for `q` odd. -/
theorem abs_sum_coefI2_div_le {U V M : ℝ} (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : 1 ≤ V) (hM : 0 ≤ M) {q : ℕ}
    (hq : Odd q) :
    |∑ a ∈ Icc 1 ⌊M⌋₊, (if Odd a ∧ q ∣ a then coefI2 U V a * (1 / a) else 0)| ≤
      (Real.log q + Real.log V) / q := by
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := hq.pos
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  set NV := ⌊V⌋₊
  set NU := ⌊U⌋₊
  set NM := ⌊M⌋₊
  set N := max NM (NV * NU)
  -- Extend the range to `N ≥ ⌊V⌋⌊U⌋`.
  have hext : ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 NM, (if Odd a ∧ q ∣ a then coefI2 U V a * (1 / a) else 0) =
      ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 N, (if (Odd a ∧ q ∣ a) ∧ a ≤ NM then coefI2 U V a * (1 / a) else 0) := by
    rw [← sum_subset (Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl (le_max_left _ _) : Icc 1 NM ⊆ Icc 1 N)
      (fun a ha hna => by
        simp only [mem_Icc] at ha hna
        rw [if_neg (fun h => by omega)])]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
    have : a ≤ NM := (mem_Icc.1 ha).2
    by_cases h : Odd a ∧ q ∣ a
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos ⟨h, this⟩]
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun h' => h h'.1)]
  rw [hext, sum_coefI2_eq (by linarith) (by linarith) _ _ (le_max_right _ _), sum_product]
  refine (abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
  -- Each `v`.
  have hv : ∀ v ∈ Icc 1 NV, |∑ u ∈ Icc 1 NU, (if (Odd (v * u) ∧ q ∣ v * u) ∧ v * u ≤ NM then
      (Λ v : ℝ) * (μ u : ℝ) * (1 / ((v * u : ℕ) : ℝ)) else 0)| ≤
      (Λ v : ℝ) * Nat.gcd q v / v * (1 / q) := by
    intro v hv
    have hv1 : 1 ≤ v := (mem_Icc.1 hv).1
    have hv0 : (0 : ℝ) < v := by exact_mod_cast hv1
    have hΛ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (n := v)
    have hgpos : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.gcd q v := by exact_mod_cast Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left v (by omega)
    have hRHS : 0 ≤ (Λ v : ℝ) * Nat.gcd q v / v * (1 / q) := by positivity
    rcases Nat.even_or_odd v with hve | hvo

        rw [if_neg]; rintro ⟨⟨ho, _⟩, _⟩
        exact (Nat.not_odd_iff_even.2 (hve.mul_right u)) ho]

    have hq'odd : Odd q' := Odd.of_dvd_nat hq (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd (Nat.gcd_dvd_left q v))
    have hq'eq : (q' : ℝ) = q / Nat.gcd q v := by
      simp only [q']; rw [Nat.cast_div (Nat.gcd_dvd_left q v) hgpos.ne']
    -- Rewrite the `u`-sum.
    have hrw : ∑ u ∈ Icc 1 NU, (if (Odd (v * u) ∧ q ∣ v * u) ∧ v * u ≤ NM then
        (Λ v : ℝ) * (μ u : ℝ) * (1 / ((v * u : ℕ) : ℝ)) else 0) =
        (Λ v : ℝ) / v * ∑ u ∈ Icc 1 (min NU (NM / v)),

      rw [mul_sum]
      rw [← sum_subset (Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl (min_le_left _ _) : Icc 1 (min NU (NM / v)) ⊆ Icc 1 NU)
        (fun u hu hnu => by
          rw [if_neg]
          rintro ⟨_, hle⟩
          simp only [mem_Icc] at hu hnu
          have : u ≤ NM / v := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hv1).2 (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hle)

      refine sum_congr rfl fun u hu => ?_
      have hule : u ≤ NM / v := (mem_Icc.1 hu).2.trans (min_le_right _ _)
      have hvu : v * u ≤ NM := by
        have := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hv1).1 hule; rw [mul_comm]; exact this

        rw [Nat.odd_mul]; exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hvo, h⟩⟩

/-- [H, p. 73]: `∑_{u ≤ K, u odd, q | u} u ≤ K²/4q + 3K/4` for `q` odd. -/
theorem sum_odd_dvd_le {q : ℕ} (hq : Odd q) (K : ℕ) :
    ∑ u ∈ Icc 1 K, (if Odd u ∧ q ∣ u then (u : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (K : ℝ) ^ 2 / (4 * q) + 3 * K / 4 := by
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := hq.pos
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  have h := sum_dvd_reindex hq1 (K : ℝ) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (fun u => (u : ℝ))
  rw [Nat.floor_natCast] at h
  rw [h]
  set N := ⌊(K : ℝ) / q⌋₊
  have hN : (N : ℝ) ≤ K / q := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  have hodd : ∀ w, Odd (q * w) ↔ Odd w := fun w => by
    rw [Nat.odd_mul]; exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hq, h⟩⟩
  have e : ∑ w ∈ Icc 1 N, (if Odd (q * w) then ((q * w : ℕ) : ℝ) else 0) =
      q * ∑ w ∈ Icc 1 N, (if Odd w then (w : ℝ) else 0) := by
    rw [mul_sum]; refine sum_congr rfl fun w _ => ?_
    by_cases ho : Odd w
    · rw [if_pos ((hodd w).2 ho), if_pos ho]; push_cast; ring
    · rw [if_neg (fun h => ho ((hodd w).1 h)), if_neg ho, mul_zero]
  rw [e]
  have hK0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ K := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with h0 | hpos
  · rw [h0]; simp; positivity
  have hqK : (q : ℝ) ≤ K := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hpos
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hq0] at hN; nlinarith
  calc (q : ℝ) * ∑ w ∈ Icc 1 N, (if Odd w then (w : ℝ) else 0)
      ≤ q * (((N : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / 4) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_odd_le N) hq0.le
    _ ≤ q * ((K / q + 1) ^ 2 / 4) := by gcongr
    _ = (K : ℝ) ^ 2 / (4 * q) + K / 2 + q / 4 := by field_simp; ring
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith

    · rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg]

    refine sum_eq_zero fun v hv => ?_

    rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩

    have : v * (a / v) ≤ NV * NU := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_floor h1) (Nat.le_floor h2)
    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' hva] at this; omega

    calc ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 NM, (if Odd a ∧ q ∣ a then |coefI2 U V a| * a else 0)

`∑_{R < m ≤ D} log m |T_{m,∘}| ≤ (3c₁/2) x (log(R+q)/R + (log D/q) log(D/R)) +

theorem sum_R3W' {α x δ Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ)) (h2α : 2 * α = a / q + δ / x + k) (hqQ : (q : ℝ) ≤ Q)
    (hδ : |δ / x| * (q * Q) ≤ 1) {R D : ℝ} (hR1 : 1 ≤ R) (hRD : R < D) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊R⌋ ⌊D⌋, Real.log n * Tn α x n ≤
      3 * (1 + eta2'L1 / (x / D)) / 2 * x *
          (Real.log (R + q) / R + Real.log D / q * Real.log (D / R)) +
        2 * √(c₀ * (1 + eta2'L1 / (x / D))) / π *

/-- Simplification of `sum_R2W` in case (b): for `q/2 < D' ≤ c₂x/q`, `1 ≤ D' ≤ D`, `2 ≤ x`. -/
theorem R2W_simp {x D D' : ℝ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hx : 2 ≤ x) (hD'q : (q : ℝ) / 2 < D')
    (hD'1 : 1 ≤ D') (hD'c : D' ≤ c₂ * x / q) (hD'D : D' ≤ D) :

      2 * √c₀ / π * (D' * (Real.log D' - 1 / 2)) +
        (2 * √c₀ / π * √(2 * c₂ * x) * (2 + 12 * Real.log (5 * D)) + 5 * c₀ / (6 * π ^ 2)) := by
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hq1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hc0 := c₀_pos
  have hc2 := c₂_pos
  have hc21 := c₂_lt_one
  have hD'0 : 0 < D' := by linarith
  set P := D' + 2 * q with hPdef
  have hP0 : 0 < P := by positivity
  have hP5 : P ≤ 5 * D := by simp only [P]; linarith
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ Real.log P - 1 / 2 := by
    have := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (show (3 : ℝ) ≤ P by simp only [P]; linarith)
    linarith [one_le_log_three]
  have hqD' : (q : ℝ) * D' ≤ c₂ * x := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hq0] at hD'c; linarith
  have hq2 : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * c₂ * x := by
    have : (q : ℝ) / 2 * q < c₂ * x := by
      have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (hD'q.trans_le hD'c) hq0
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hq0.ne'] at this
    nlinarith
  have hqx : (q : ℝ) ≤ x := by nlinarith
  have hqP : (q : ℝ) * P ^ 2 ≤ c₂ * x * (D' + 12 * q) := by
    have e : (q : ℝ) * P ^ 2 = (q * D') * D' + 4 * q * (q * D') + 4 * q * q ^ 2 := by
      simp only [P]; ring
    rw [e]
    have h1 : (q * D') * D' ≤ (c₂ * x) * D' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hqD' hD'0.le
    have h2 : 4 * q * (q * D') ≤ 4 * q * (c₂ * x) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqD' (by positivity)
    have h3 : 4 * q * q ^ 2 ≤ 4 * q * (2 * c₂ * x) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq2 (by positivity)

    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hP0 hD'0)

    have e : D' * (P / D' - 1) = 2 * q := by simp only [P]; field_simp; ring

    have := Real.log_le_log hP0 hP5; linarith
  have hlog5 : 0 ≤ Real.log (5 * D) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)

  have hmain : 10 * c₀ * q / (3 * π ^ 2 * x) * (P ^ 2 / 2 * (Real.log P - 1 / 2)) ≤

/-- Weighted range (R3) (cf. [H, (4.61)–(4.62)]), general form: for `1 ≤ R < D`, with
`c₁ = 1 + |η'|₁/(x/D)`,
`∑_{R < m ≤ D} log m |T_{m,∘}| ≤ (3c₁/2) x (log(R+q)/R + (log D/q) log(D/R)) +
(2√(c₀c₁)/π)(√(1+q/R) q log(R+q) + D(log D - 1) - R(log R - 1) + 2q log(D/R) + (q/2) log D log(D/R))`. -/
theorem sum_R3W' {α x δ Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ)) (h2α : 2 * α = a / q + δ / x + k) (hqQ : (q : ℝ) ≤ Q)
    (hδ : |δ / x| * (q * Q) ≤ 1) {R D : ℝ} (hR1 : 1 ≤ R) (hRD : R < D) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊R⌋ ⌊D⌋, Real.log n * Tn α x n ≤
      3 * (1 + eta2'L1 / (x / D)) / 2 * x *
          (Real.log (R + q) / R + Real.log D / q * Real.log (D / R)) +
        2 * √(c₀ * (1 + eta2'L1 / (x / D))) / π *
          (q * √(1 + q / R) * Real.log (R + q) + (D * (Real.log D - 1) - R * (Real.log R - 1)) +
            2 * q * Real.log (D / R) + q / 2 * Real.log D * Real.log (D / R)) := by

theorem log_three_mul_div_le {R R₀ : ℝ} (hR₀ : 1 / 3 ≤ R₀) (hR : R₀ ≤ R) :
    Real.log (3 * R) / R ≤ (Real.log (3 * R₀) + 1) / R₀ := by

  have hR0 : 0 < R := hR₀0.trans_le hR

    rw [← Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]; congr 1; field_simp
  have hl : Real.log (R / R₀) ≤ R / R₀ - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity)
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hR0 hR₀0, hsplit]
  have e : (R / R₀ - 1) * R₀ = R - R₀ := by field_simp
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hl hR₀0.le]

/-- The main-term constant: `(∑_{e|P} μ(e)/e) · ∑_{(m,P)=1} μ(m)/m² = (6/π²) · P/σ(P)`. -/
theorem sqfree_density {P : ℕ} (hP : Squarefree P) :
    (∑ e ∈ P.divisors, (μ e : ℝ) / e) *
      ∑' m : ℕ, (if Nat.Coprime m P then (μ m : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) ^ 2 else 0) =
      6 / Real.pi ^ 2 * (P / σ 1 P) := by
  rw [sum_moebius_div_eq_prod hP, tsum_coprime_moebius_div_sq hP.ne_zero, sigma_eq_prod hP]
  have hP' : (P : ℝ) = ∏ p ∈ P.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_prod, Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hP]
  rw [hP']
  have hp2 : ∀ p ∈ P.primeFactors, (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := fun p hp => by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).two_le
  have hne : ∏ p ∈ P.primeFactors, (1 - 1 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2) ≠ 0 :=
    prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun p hp => by
      have := hp2 p hp
      have : 1 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2 < 1 := by rw [div_lt_one (by positivity)]; nlinarith
      linarith
  have hne2 : ∏ p ∈ P.primeFactors, ((p : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 :=
    prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun p hp => by have := hp2 p hp; positivity
  have key : (∏ p ∈ P.primeFactors, (1 - 1 / (p : ℝ))) * ∏ p ∈ P.primeFactors, ((p : ℝ) + 1) =
      (∏ p ∈ P.primeFactors, (1 - 1 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2)) * ∏ p ∈ P.primeFactors, (p : ℝ) := by
    rw [← prod_mul_distrib, ← prod_mul_distrib]
    refine prod_congr rfl fun p hp => ?_
    have := hp2 p hp
    field_simp
    ring
  have hpi : Real.pi ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp
  linear_combination key

  ∑' m : ℕ, if Squarefree m ∧ m ≠ 0 then (if (m : ℝ) ≤ X then 1 else X ^ 2 / (2 * (m : ℝ) ^ 2))
    else 0

/-- **`f(X) ≤ 1.27 X` for `X ≥ 0`** ([H, p. 83]). -/
theorem fsq_le' {X : ℝ} (hX : 0 ≤ X) : ∑' m, fsqTerm X m ≤ 1.27 * X := by
  rw [fsq_split hX]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, ⌊X⌋₊ = n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hn1 : (n : ℝ) ≤ X := by rw [← hn]; exact Nat.floor_le hX
  have hn2 : X < n + 1 := by rw [← hn]; exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one X
  rw [hn]
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S, ∑' k, sqInd (k + (n + 1)) / ((k + (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 = S :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [hSdef]
  have hS0 : 0 ≤ S := by
    rw [← hSdef]; exact tsum_nonneg fun k => div_nonneg (sqInd_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  have hX2 : 0 ≤ X ^ 2 / 2 := by positivity
  rcases lt_or_ge n 200 with h200 | h200
  · -- the kernel-checked range
    obtain ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ := chk_prop h200
    have hQ : ∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), sqInd m ≤ ((Qc n : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
      unfold Qc; push_cast; exact sum_le_sum fun m _ => sqInd_le_cq m
    have hS : S ≤ ((Sc n : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
      have hMn : n < Mn n := by unfold Mn; split_ifs <;> omega
      have h := tail_le (n + 1) (Mn n - n) (by omega) (by omega)
      have e : ((Mn n - n + (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1 = (Mn n : ℝ) := by
        rw [show Mn n - n + (n + 1) = Mn n + 1 by omega]; push_cast; ring
      rw [e, hSdef] at h
      unfold Sc; push_cast at h ⊢; exact h
    have hSc0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((Sc n : ℚ) : ℝ) := hS0.trans hS
    have hc1' := (Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ)).2 hc1
    have hc2' := (Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ)).2 hc2
    push_cast at hc1' hc2'
    have hmono : X ^ 2 / 2 * S ≤ X ^ 2 / 2 * ((Sc n : ℚ) : ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS hX2
    -- concavity between `n` and `n + 1`
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ X - n := by linarith
    have ht1 : 0 ≤ n + 1 - X := by linarith
    have hconc : ((Qc n : ℚ) : ℝ) + X ^ 2 / 2 * ((Sc n : ℚ) : ℝ) ≤ 1.27 * X := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht1 (sub_nonneg.2 hc1'), mul_nonneg ht0 (sub_nonneg.2 hc2'),
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht0 ht1) hSc0]
    linarith
  · -- `n ≥ 200`
    have hQ := Q_le n
    have hn0 : (200 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast h200
    have hS : S ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ) := by
      have hs : Summable (fun k : ℕ => 1 / ((k + (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
        (summable_nat_add_iff (n + 1)).2 (Real.summable_one_div_nat_pow.2 one_lt_two)
      have h1 : ∑' k, sqInd (k + (n + 1)) / ((k + (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
          ∑' k : ℕ, 1 / ((k + (n + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun k => div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (sqInd_le_one _) (by positivity))
          (summable_sqInd_div (n + 1)) hs
      have h2 := tsum_inv_sq_tail (M := n + 1) (by omega)
      have e : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1 = n := by push_cast; ring
      rw [e] at h2
      rw [hSdef] at h1
      linarith
    have hQ' : ((n - n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (3 * n + 3) / 4 := by
      have h4 : n ≤ 4 * (n / 4) + 3 := by omega
      have h4' : ((n : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ((n / 4 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 3 := by exact_mod_cast h4
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (Nat.div_le_self n 4)]
      linarith
    have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by linarith
    have hXS : X ^ 2 / 2 * S ≤ X ^ 2 / 2 * (1 / (n : ℝ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS hX2
    have hXn : X ^ 2 / 2 * (1 / (n : ℝ)) ≤ X / 2 + X / 400 := by
      have h1 : X ^ 2 ≤ X * (n + 1) := by nlinarith
      have h2 : X ≤ X * n / 200 := by
        rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; nlinarith
      rw [mul_one_div, div_div, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    linarith

theorem g2_eq_sum_dvd (x : ℝ) :

  unfold g2
  simp_rw [g2_term_eq]
  -- `[coprime] = ∑_{d ∣ gcd} μ(d)`
  have hcop : ∀ r₁ r₂ : ℕ, (if Nat.Coprime r₁ r₂ then fo r₁ * fo r₂ else 0) =
      ∑ d ∈ (Nat.gcd r₁ r₂).divisors, (μ d : ℝ) * (fo r₁ * fo r₂) := by
    intro r₁ r₂
    rw [← sum_mul, g2_sum_moebius_divisors]
    simp only [Nat.Coprime]; split_ifs <;> simp
  simp_rw [hcop]
  -- swap: `∑_{r₁, r₂} ∑_{d ∣ (r₁, r₂)} = ∑_d ∑_{d ∣ r₁} ∑_{d ∣ r₂}`
  have hswap : ∀ r₁ ∈ Icc 1 N, ∀ r₂ ∈ Icc 1 N,
      ∑ d ∈ (Nat.gcd r₁ r₂).divisors, (μ d : ℝ) * (fo r₁ * fo r₂) =
        ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 N, if d ∣ r₁ ∧ d ∣ r₂ then (μ d : ℝ) * (fo r₁ * fo r₂) else 0 := by
    intro r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂
    rw [← sum_filter]

    have h1 := (mem_Icc.1 hr₁).1; have h2 := (mem_Icc.1 hr₁).2

      have hpos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hd1 (by omega)
      exact ⟨⟨hpos, (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd1).trans h2⟩, hd1, hd2⟩

  refine sum_congr rfl fun r₁ _ => ?_
  rw [mul_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun r₂ _ => ?_

  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hlx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos hx
  have hy1 : 1 ≤ x / u := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hu0]; linarith
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ 0.03 * (u : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) / Real.log x := by positivity
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ √2 * √(u : ℝ) / √x := by positivity

    have hw : 9 ≤ Real.log (x / u) := le_trans log_11815_ge9 (Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) h)

      have : (1 + Real.log u / 9) * Real.log (x / u) ≤

  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast hd1
  rw [Sd_eq]
  refine (abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
  have hterm : ∀ a ∈ Icc 1 (⌊x⌋₊ / d),
      |Hd d a * ∑ b ∈ Icc 1 (⌊x⌋₊ / d / a), (μ b : ℝ) / b| ≤
        0.03 * (d : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) / Real.log x * (Hd d a * (a : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9)) +
        √2 * √(d : ℝ) / √x * (Hd d a * (a : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 2)) := by

    have ha1 := (mem_Icc.1 ha).1
    have haN := (mem_Icc.1 ha).2

      rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hd1] at haN; rw [mul_comm]; exact haN
    have hu1 : 1 ≤ d * a := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (Nat.mul_ne_zero (by omega) (by omega))
    have hux : ((d * a : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ x :=

    have hfl : ⌊x⌋₊ / d / a = ⌊x / ((d * a : ℕ) : ℝ)⌋₊ := by
      rw [Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, Nat.floor_div_natCast]

/-- **`∑_{a ≤ A} H_d(a) a^s ≤ c_s(2) ∏_{2 < p ≤ A} ℓ_s(p) ∏_{p ∣ d} ρ_s(p)`** (odd `d`). -/
theorem sum_Hd_rpow_le {d : ℕ} (hd : Odd d) {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s < 1) (A : ℕ) :
    ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 A, Hd d a * (a : ℝ) ^ s ≤
      cfac s 2 * (∏ p ∈ (Nat.primesBelow (A + 1)).filter (· ≠ 2), ell s p) *
        ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, rho s p := by
  have h := sum_le_euler (f := fun a => Hd d a * (a : ℝ) ^ s)
    (fun n => mul_nonneg (Hd_nonneg d n) (by positivity))
    (by simp [(isMultiplicative_Hd d).map_one])
    (fun {m n} hmn => by
      simp only [(isMultiplicative_Hd d).map_mul_of_coprime hmn, Nat.cast_mul,
        Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]; ring)
    (fun hp => by
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using (summable_Hd_rpow (d := d) hp hs1).abs) A
  refine h.trans ?_
  rw [prod_congr rfl fun p hp => tsum_Hd_rpow (d := d) (Nat.mem_primesBelow.1 hp).2 hs1]
  have hd2 : ¬ 2 ∣ d := by rw [← even_iff_two_dvd]; exact Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 hd
  have hfac : ∀ p ∈ Nat.primesBelow (A + 1), (if p ≠ 2 ∧ ¬ p ∣ d then ell s p else cfac s p) =

    intro p hp
    have hpp := (Nat.mem_primesBelow.1 hp).2
    by_cases h2 : p = 2
    · subst h2; simp [hd2]
    · by_cases hpd : p ∣ d
      · simp [h2, hpd, ell_mul_rho hs1 hpp.two_le]
      · simp [h2, hpd]
  rw [prod_congr rfl hfac, prod_mul_distrib, prod_ite, ← prod_filter]
  set P := Nat.primesBelow (A + 1)
  have hP2 : ∀ p ∈ P, 2 ≤ p := fun p hp => (Nat.mem_primesBelow.1 hp).2.two_le
  have hc1 := one_le_cfac hs0 hs1 (le_refl 2)
  have hA1 : ∏ p ∈ P.filter (· = 2), cfac s 2 ≤ cfac s 2 := by
    rw [prod_const]
    have hcard : (P.filter (· = 2)).card ≤ 1 :=
      card_le_one.2 fun a ha b hb => by
        simp only [mem_filter] at ha hb; rw [ha.2, hb.2]
    calc cfac s 2 ^ (P.filter (· = 2)).card ≤ cfac s 2 ^ 1 := pow_le_pow_right₀ hc1 hcard
      _ = cfac s 2 := pow_one _
  have hA3 : ∏ p ∈ P.filter (· ∣ d), rho s p ≤ ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, rho s p := by
    refine prod_le_prod_of_subset_of_one_le₀ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro p hp
      simp only [mem_filter] at hp
      exact Nat.mem_primeFactors.2 ⟨(Nat.mem_primesBelow.1 hp.1).2, hp.2, by
        rintro rfl; exact hd2 (dvd_zero 2)⟩
    · intro p hp
      linarith [one_le_rho hs0 hs1 (Nat.mem_primesBelow.1 (mem_filter.1 hp).1).2.two_le]
    · intro p hp _
      exact one_le_rho hs0 hs1 (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).two_le
  have hell0 : 0 ≤ ∏ p ∈ P.filter (fun p => ¬ p = 2), ell s p :=
    prod_nonneg fun p hp => by
      linarith [one_le_ell hs1 (hP2 p (mem_filter.1 hp).1)]
  have hrho0 : 0 ≤ ∏ p ∈ P.filter (· ∣ d), rho s p :=
    prod_nonneg fun p hp => by
      linarith [one_le_rho hs0 hs1 (hP2 p (mem_filter.1 hp).1)]
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ ∏ p ∈ P.filter (· = 2), cfac s 2 := prod_nonneg fun _ _ => by linarith
  calc (∏ p ∈ P.filter (· = 2), cfac s 2) * (∏ p ∈ P.filter (fun p => ¬ p = 2), ell s p) *
        ∏ p ∈ P.filter (· ∣ d), rho s p
      ≤ cfac s 2 * (∏ p ∈ P.filter (fun p => ¬ p = 2), ell s p) * ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, rho s p := by
        gcongr
    _ = _ := rfl

snippet.text:
/-- The large sieve (optimal form) for `S(β)`: for `δ`-separated points (`0 < δ ≤ 1`),
`∑_r |S(β_r)|² ≤ (W - W' + δ⁻¹) ∑ (log p)²`. -/
theorem large_sieve_primes {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (β : ι → ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hsep : ∀ r ∈ s, ∀ r' ∈ s, r ≠ r' → δ ≤ |(β r - β r') - round (β r - β r')|)
    {W' W : ℝ} (hW' : 0 ≤ W') :
    ∑ r ∈ s, ‖primeExpSum W' W (β r)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (W - W' + δ⁻¹) * logSqSum W' W := by
  rcases lt_or_ge ⌊W'⌋₊ ⌊W⌋₊ with hlt | hge
  · set M := ⌊W'⌋₊
    set N := ⌊W⌋₊ - M
    have hMN : M + N = ⌊W⌋₊ := by omega
    set a : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => if n.Prime then (Real.log n : ℂ) else 0
    have hS : ∀ t, primeExpSum W' W t = ∑ n ∈ Ioc M (M + N), a n * e (t * n) := by
      intro t
      rw [primeExpSum, hMN, sum_filter]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      simp only [a]; split_ifs <;> simp
    have hL : logSqSum W' W = ∑ n ∈ Ioc M (M + N), ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [logSqSum, hMN, sum_filter]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      simp only [a]; split_ifs
      · rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      · simp
    simp_rw [hS]
    rw [hL]
    refine (Prelim.large_sieve_opt s β hδ hδ1 hsep M N a).trans ?_
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hW0 : 0 ≤ W := by
      by_contra h; push Not at h
      have : ⌊W⌋₊ = 0 := Nat.floor_eq_zero.2 (by linarith)
      omega
    have h1 : (⌊W⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ W := Nat.floor_le hW0
    have h2 : W' < (⌊W'⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one W'
    have hN : (N : ℝ) = ⌊W⌋₊ - ⌊W'⌋₊ := by
      simp only [N, M]; rw [Nat.cast_sub hlt.le]
    rw [hN]; linarith
  · have hempty : Ioc ⌊W'⌋₊ ⌊W⌋₊ = ∅ := Ioc_eq_empty (not_lt.2 hge)
    simp [primeExpSum, logSqSum, hempty]

/-- **Montgomery's inequality** (case `ω(p) = 1`): for squarefree `r` and `a(n)` supported on
`n` coprime to `r`, `|S(α)|² ≤ φ(r) ∑_{b < r, (b,r)=1} |S(α + b/r)|²`. -/
theorem montgomery_ineq {r : ℕ} (hr : Squarefree r) (s : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hs : ∀ n ∈ s, Nat.Coprime n r) (α : ℝ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e (α * n)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (Nat.totient r : ℝ) * ∑ b ∈ (range r).filter r.Coprime,
        ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n)‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; exact not_squarefree_zero hr)
  set T := (range r).filter r.Coprime
  have hsum : ∑ b ∈ T, ∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n) =
      (μ r : ℂ) * ∑ n ∈ s, a n * e (α * n) := by
    rw [sum_comm, mul_sum]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
    have : ∀ b ∈ T, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n) = a n * e (α * n) * e (b * n / r) := by
      intro b _; rw [mul_assoc, ← e_add]; congr 2; ring
    rw [sum_congr rfl this, ← mul_sum, ramanujan_coprime r n hr1 (hs n hn)]
    ring
  have hμ : ‖(μ r : ℂ)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.norm_intCast]; exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_eq_one_of_squarefree hr
  have h1 : ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e (α * n)‖ ≤ ∑ b ∈ T, ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n)‖ := by
    have := norm_sum_le T (fun b => ∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n))
    rw [hsum, norm_mul, hμ, one_mul] at this; exact this
  have h2 := sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq (s := T) (f := fun b => ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n)‖)
  have hcard : (#T : ℝ) = Nat.totient r := by rw [Nat.totient_eq_card_coprime]
  rw [hcard] at h2
  calc ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e (α * n)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ b ∈ T, ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n)‖) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h1 2
    _ ≤ _ := h2

      refine sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
      rw [sum_mul]

theorem sep_odd {α Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ))
    (hα : |2 * α - a / q - k| ≤ 1 / (q * Q)) (hQ : 0 < Q) {m m' : ℤ} (hm : Odd m) (hm' : Odd m')
    (hne : m ≠ m') {K : ℝ} (hK : |((m - m' : ℤ) : ℝ)| / 2 ≤ K) (hKq : K < q) :
    1 / q - K / (q * Q) ≤ |(α * m - α * m') - round (α * m - α * m')| := by
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j : ℤ, m - m' = 2 * j := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hm; obtain ⟨u', hu'⟩ := hm'; exact ⟨u - u', by omega⟩
  have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hjK : (|j| : ℝ) ≤ K := by
    rw [hj] at hK; push_cast at hK; rw [abs_mul] at hK; norm_num at hK; exact_mod_cast hK
  have hjq : |j| < q := by exact_mod_cast hjK.trans_lt hKq
  have e : α * m - α * m' = 2 * α * j := by
    have : (m : ℝ) - m' = 2 * j := by exact_mod_cast hj
    linear_combination α * this
  rw [e]
  refine le_trans ?_ (dist_two_alpha_mul hq hcop hα hQ hj0 hjq)
  have : (|j| : ℝ) / (q * Q) ≤ K / (q * Q) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hjK (by positivity)
  push_cast at this ⊢; linarith

/-- The large sieve (optimal form) for `S(β)`: for `δ`-separated points (`0 < δ ≤ 1`),
`∑_r |S(β_r)|² ≤ (W - W' + δ⁻¹) ∑ (log p)²`. -/
theorem large_sieve_primes {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (β : ι → ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hsep : ∀ r ∈ s, ∀ r' ∈ s, r ≠ r' → δ ≤ |(β r - β r') - round (β r - β r')|)
    {W' W : ℝ} (hW' : 0 ≤ W') :
    ∑ r ∈ s, ‖primeExpSum W' W (β r)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (W - W' + δ⁻¹) * logSqSum W' W := by
  rcases lt_or_ge ⌊W'⌋₊ ⌊W⌋₊ with hlt | hge
  · set M := ⌊W'⌋₊
    set N := ⌊W⌋₊ - M
    have hMN : M + N = ⌊W⌋₊ := by omega
    set a : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => if n.Prime then (Real.log n : ℂ) else 0
    have hS : ∀ t, primeExpSum W' W t = ∑ n ∈ Ioc M (M + N), a n * e (t * n) := by
      intro t
      rw [primeExpSum, hMN, sum_filter]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      simp only [a]; split_ifs <;> simp
    have hL : logSqSum W' W = ∑ n ∈ Ioc M (M + N), ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [logSqSum, hMN, sum_filter]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      simp only [a]; split_ifs
      · rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      · simp
    simp_rw [hS]
    rw [hL]
    refine (Prelim.large_sieve_opt s β hδ hδ1 hsep M N a).trans ?_
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hW0 : 0 ≤ W := by
      by_contra h; push Not at h
      have : ⌊W⌋₊ = 0 := Nat.floor_eq_zero.2 (by linarith)
      omega
    have h1 : (⌊W⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ W := Nat.floor_le hW0
    have h2 : W' < (⌊W'⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one W'
    have hN : (N : ℝ) = ⌊W⌋₊ - ⌊W'⌋₊ := by
      simp only [N, M]; rw [Nat.cast_sub hlt.le]
    rw [hN]; linarith
  · have hempty : Ioc ⌊W'⌋₊ ⌊W⌋₊ = ∅ := Ioc_eq_empty (not_lt.2 hge)
    simp [primeExpSum, logSqSum, hempty]

theorem two_log_le_sub_inv {z : ℝ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) : 2 * Real.log z ≤ z - 1 / z := by
  have hderiv : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → HasDerivAt (fun t => t - 1 / t - 2 * Real.log t)
      (1 + 1 / t ^ 2 - 2 / t) t := by
    intro t ht
    have h := ((hasDerivAt_id' t).sub ((hasDerivAt_inv ht.ne').const_mul 1)).sub
      ((Real.hasDerivAt_log ht.ne').const_mul 2)
    convert h using 1
    · funext s; simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
    · field_simp; ring
  have hmono := monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (f := fun t => t - 1 / t - 2 * Real.log t)
    (convex_Ici 1)
    (fun u hu => (hderiv u (by linarith [Set.mem_Ici.1 hu])).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun u hu => by
      rw [interior_Ici] at hu
      exact (hderiv u (by linarith [Set.mem_Ioi.1 hu])).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
    (fun u hu => by
      rw [interior_Ici] at hu
      have hu1 : (1 : ℝ) < u := hu
      rw [(hderiv u (by linarith)).deriv]
      have : 1 + 1 / u ^ 2 - 2 / u = (1 - 1 / u) ^ 2 := by field_simp; ring
      rw [this]; positivity)
  have := hmono (Set.mem_Ici.2 le_rfl) (Set.mem_Ici.2 hz) hz
  simp only [div_one, Real.log_one, mul_zero, sub_zero, sub_self] at this
  linarith

/-- Odd `m ≠ m'` with `|m - m'| ≤ 2K - 1` are separated by `≥ 1/q - (K-1)/(qQ)`: `m - m' = 2j`,
`0 < |j| ≤ K - 1`. -/
theorem sep_odd {α Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ))
    (hα : |2 * α - a / q - k| ≤ 1 / (q * Q)) (hQ : 0 < Q) {m m' : ℤ} (hm : Odd m) (hm' : Odd m')
    (hne : m ≠ m') {K : ℝ} (hK : |((m - m' : ℤ) : ℝ)| / 2 ≤ K) (hKq : K < q) :
    1 / q - K / (q * Q) ≤ |(α * m - α * m') - round (α * m - α * m')| := by
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j : ℤ, m - m' = 2 * j := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hm; obtain ⟨u', hu'⟩ := hm'; exact ⟨u - u', by omega⟩
  have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hjK : (|j| : ℝ) ≤ K := by
    rw [hj] at hK; push_cast at hK; rw [abs_mul] at hK; norm_num at hK; exact_mod_cast hK
  have hjq : |j| < q := by exact_mod_cast hjK.trans_lt hKq
  have e : α * m - α * m' = 2 * α * j := by
    have : (m : ℝ) - m' = 2 * j := by exact_mod_cast hj
    linear_combination α * this
  rw [e]
  refine le_trans ?_ (dist_two_alpha_mul hq hcop hα hQ hj0 hjq)
  have : (|j| : ℝ) / (q * Q) ≤ K / (q * Q) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hjK (by positivity)
  push_cast at this ⊢; linarith

proof_context.conclusion: With |m-m'|/2 <= K-1 and K-1 < Q/2 this gives separation >= 1/q - 1/(2q) = 1/(2q), the δ of `large_sieve_primes`.

/-- The approximation of `2vα` induced by `2α = a/q + δ/x`: `2vα = a_v/q_v + δ/(x/v)` with
`q_v = q/(q,v)`, `a_v = a·v/(q,v)`, valid with `Q_v = Q/v` when `qv ≤ Q`. -/
theorem approx2_mul {α x δ Q : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (h : Approx2 α x δ a q Q) (hx : 0 < x) {v : ℕ}
    (hv : 1 ≤ v) (hqv : (q : ℝ) * v ≤ Q) :
    Approx2 (v * α) (x / v) δ (a * (v / Nat.gcd q v : ℕ)) (q / Nat.gcd q v) (Q / v) := by
  obtain ⟨hq, hcop, ⟨k, h2α⟩, hδQ, hqQ⟩ := h
  have hv0 : (0 : ℝ) < v := by exact_mod_cast hv
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  set g := Nat.gcd q v
  have hg : 0 < g := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ hq
  obtain ⟨q', hq'⟩ : g ∣ q := Nat.gcd_dvd_left q v
  obtain ⟨v', hv'⟩ : g ∣ v := Nat.gcd_dvd_right q v
  have hqd : q / g = q' := by rw [hq', Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg]
  have hvd : v / g = v' := by rw [hv', Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg]
  have hcop' : Nat.Coprime q' v' := by
    have := Nat.coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd (m := q) (n := v) hg
    rwa [hqd, hvd] at this
  rw [hqd, hvd]
  have hq'1 : 1 ≤ q' := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; simp at hq'; omega)
  have hg0 : (0 : ℝ) < g := by exact_mod_cast hg
  have hq'0 : (0 : ℝ) < q' := by exact_mod_cast hq'1
  have hq'q : (q' : ℝ) ≤ q := by
    rw [hq']; push_cast; nlinarith [show (1 : ℝ) ≤ g by exact_mod_cast hg]
  refine ⟨hq'1, ?_, ⟨v * k, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- `(a v', q') = 1`.
    have h1 : IsCoprime a (q' : ℤ) := by
      have : (q' : ℤ) ∣ q := ⟨g, by rw [hq']; push_cast; ring⟩
      exact hcop.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_right this
    have h2 : IsCoprime ((v' : ℕ) : ℤ) (q' : ℤ) :=
      Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hcop'.symm
    exact h1.mul_left h2
  · -- `2vα = a v'/q' + δ/(x/v) + vk`.
    have : (a : ℝ) * v' / q' = a * v / q := by
      rw [hq', hv']; push_cast; field_simp
    push_cast
    rw [this]
    have h2 := congrArg (fun t => (v : ℝ) * t) h2α
    rw [div_div_eq_mul_div]
    field_simp at h2 ⊢
    linarith
  · have hQ0 : 0 < Q := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hqv
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hx, div_le_div_iff₀ hx (by positivity), one_mul] at hδQ
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (div_pos hx hv0), div_le_div_iff₀ (div_pos hx hv0) (by positivity),
      one_mul]
    have : |δ| * (q' * (Q / v)) ≤ |δ| * (q * Q) / v := by
      rw [show |δ| * (q' * (Q / v)) = |δ| * (q' * Q) / v by ring]
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq'q hQ0.le) (abs_nonneg _)) hv0.le
    calc |δ| * (q' * (Q / v)) ≤ |δ| * (q * Q) / v := this
      _ ≤ x / v := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hδQ hv0.le
  · rw [le_div_iff₀ hv0]; nlinarith

  rw [integral_etaPlus_sq_log_eq hx0]

  have iB : Integrable fun u => gL u * W1 u := memLp_gL.integrable_mul memLp_W1
  have iC : Integrable fun u => Dg u * W0 u := memLp_Dg.integrable_mul memLp_W0
  have iD : Integrable fun u => Dg u * W1 u := memLp_Dg.integrable_mul memLp_W1

    ((continuous_Dg.pow 2).mul continuous_Ew).aestronglyMeasurable
  have iE : Integrable fun u => Dg u ^ 2 * Ew u :=

      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (Ew_nonneg u))]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Ew_le u) (sq_nonneg _))
  have mF : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun u => Dg u ^ 2 * Ew u * u) :=
    (((continuous_Dg.pow 2).mul continuous_Ew).mul continuous_id).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hF : ∀ u, |Dg u ^ 2 * Ew u * u| ≤ Dg u ^ 2 * 0.37 := by
    intro u
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), abs_of_nonneg (Ew_nonneg u), mul_assoc,
      mul_comm (Ew u)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_mul_Ew_le u) (sq_nonneg _)

  have hC0 := abs_integral_Dg_mul_le hasDerivAt_W0 hasDerivAt_W0' integrable_W0 integrable_W0'
    integrable_W0'' integrable_W0''_sq memLp_W0 continuous_W0 m0 (lam := 1.6) (by norm_num)
  have hC1 := abs_integral_Dg_mul_le hasDerivAt_W1 hasDerivAt_W1' integrable_W1 integrable_W1'

  have hQ0 : |∫ u, Dg u ^ 2 * Ew u| ≤ 368 / 200 ^ 4 / 2 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun u => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (Ew_nonneg u))]
    calc ∫ u, Dg u ^ 2 * Ew u ≤ ∫ u, Dg u ^ 2 * (1 / 2) :=

      _ ≤ ∫ u, Dg u ^ 2 * 0.37 := integral_mono iF.abs (integrable_Dg_sq.mul_const _) hF

  set B := ∫ u, gL u * W1 u

/-- **The tail above `T₀`** (`T₀ ≥ 200 + max(10π|δ|, 50)`). -/
theorem norm_mellin_fP_tail {δ T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : 200 + max (10 * π * |δ|) 50 ≤ T0) {s : ℂ}
    (hr1 : 0 < s.re) (hr2 : s.re < 1) (hτ : T0 < |s.im|) :
    ‖mellin (fP δ) s‖ ≤ Cg * (2 * aH) * EB (T0 - 200) * rhoB ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ +
      Cg * (2 * aH) * EA (T0 - 200) δ * rhoA δ ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ := by
  set k := ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ with hk
  have hT0' : max (10 * π * |δ|) 50 ≤ T0 - 200 := by linarith
  have h := norm_mellin_fP_le δ (s := s) (by linarith)
    (B := EB (T0 - 200) * rhoB ^ k + EA (T0 - 200) δ * rhoA δ ^ k) fun ξ hξ => by
    have hsh := abs_shift_le hξ
    have ha : |s.im| - 200 ≤ |s.im + 2 * π * ξ| := by
      have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub s.im (-(2 * π * ξ)); rw [abs_neg] at this
      have e : s.im - -(2 * π * ξ) = s.im + 2 * π * ξ := by ring
      rw [e] at this; linarith
    have hτ' : T0 - 200 < |(s - 1 + ((2 * π * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * I).im| := by rw [im_shift]; linarith
    have hG := norm_G_tail_floor hT0' (by rw [re_shift]; linarith) (by rw [re_shift]; linarith) hτ'
    rw [im_shift] at hG
    refine hG.trans ?_
    have hkk : k ≤ ⌊(|s.im + 2 * π * ξ| - (T0 - 200)) / 4.4⌋₊ := by
      rw [hk]; apply Nat.floor_le_floor
      apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by norm_num); linarith
    have hB1 : rhoB ^ ⌊(|s.im + 2 * π * ξ| - (T0 - 200)) / 4.4⌋₊ ≤ rhoB ^ k :=
      pow_le_pow_of_le_one (Real.exp_pos _).le rhoB_lt_one.le hkk
    have hA1 : rhoA δ ^ ⌊(|s.im + 2 * π * ξ| - (T0 - 200)) / 4.4⌋₊ ≤ rhoA δ ^ k :=
      pow_le_pow_of_le_one (Real.exp_pos _).le (rhoA_lt_one δ).le hkk
    have hEB := EB_nonneg (by linarith [le_max_right (10 * π * |δ|) 50] : (0:ℝ) ≤ T0 - 200)
    have hEA := EA_nonneg (T0 - 200) δ
    gcongr
  refine h.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  ring
