/-- **The sum over zeros** (generic). -/
theorem zero_sum_boundG (hp : PolyDatum f B κ)
    (hcls : ∀ T : ℝ, ∀ u ∈ zerosRectD f T, f u = 0 ∧ (u = 0 ∨ (0 < u.re ∧ u.re < 1)))
    {T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : 50 ≤ T0)
    (hG : ∀ ρ : ℂ, f ρ = 0 → 0 < ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 → |ρ.im| ≤ T0 → ρ.re = 1 / 2)
    (M : ℂ → ℂ) {G0 : ℝ} (hM0 : ‖M 0‖ ≤ G0)
    {F F' : ℝ → ℂ} (hMF : ∀ t : ℝ, M (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I) = F t)
    (hF : ∀ t, HasDerivAt F (F' t) t) (hF' : Continuous F')
    {Q1 Q2 : ℝ} (hQ1 : 0 < Q1) (hQ2 : 0 < Q2)
    (hF2 : Integrable fun t => ‖F t‖ ^ 2) (hF2' : Integrable fun t => ‖F' t‖ ^ 2)
    (hFQ : ∫ t, ‖F t‖ ^ 2 ≤ Q1) (hFQ' : ∫ t, ‖F' t‖ ^ 2 ≤ Q2)
    {EB' EA' ρB ρA : ℝ} (hEB : 0 ≤ EB') (hEA : 0 ≤ EA') (hρB0 : 0 ≤ ρB) (hρB1 : ρB < 1)
    (hρA0 : 0 ≤ ρA) (hρA1 : ρA < 1)
    (htail : ∀ s : ℂ, 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → T0 < |s.im| →
      ‖M s‖ ≤ EB' * ρB ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ + EA' * ρA ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (T : ℝ) :
    ‖∑ u ∈ zerosRectD f T, (multRectD f T u : ℂ) * (M u * (x : ℂ) ^ u)‖ ≤
      G0 * Z3g B 0 + √x * E1g B T0 Q1 Q2 + x * E2g B κ T0 EB' EA' ρB ρA := by
  set Z := zerosRectD f T with hZ
  set m : ℂ → ℝ := fun u => (multRectD f T u : ℝ) with hmdef
  have hm : ∀ u, 0 ≤ m u := fun u => Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hT00 : 0 < T0 := by linarith
  have h1 : ‖∑ u ∈ Z, (multRectD f T u : ℂ) * (M u * (x : ℂ) ^ u)‖ ≤
      ∑ u ∈ Z, m u * (‖M u‖ * x ^ u.re) := by
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun u _ => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, norm_cpow_x hx0]
  refine h1.trans ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Z (fun u => u = 0),
    ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (Z.filter fun u => ¬ u = 0) (fun u => |u.im| ≤ T0)]
  have hcases : ∀ u ∈ Z.filter (fun u => ¬ u = 0), f u = 0 ∧ 0 < u.re ∧ u.re < 1 := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨huZ, hu0⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hu
    obtain ⟨hL, hc⟩ := hcls T u huZ
    rcases hc with h | h
    · exact absurd h hu0
    · exact ⟨hL, h⟩
  have hG00 : 0 ≤ G0 := (norm_nonneg _).trans hM0
  -- the zero at `0`
  have hA : ∑ u ∈ Z.filter (fun u => u = 0), m u * (‖M u‖ * x ^ u.re) ≤ G0 * Z3g B 0 := by
    have hcount := sum_multRectD_le hp (Z.filter fun u => u = 0) (Finset.filter_subset _ _) 0
      (r := 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (fun u hu => by
        rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2]; norm_num)
    have hpt : ∀ u ∈ Z.filter (fun u => u = 0), m u * (‖M u‖ * x ^ u.re) ≤ m u * G0 := by
      intro u hu
      rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2, Complex.zero_re, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hM0 (hm 0)
    refine (Finset.sum_le_sum hpt).trans ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, mul_comm]
    have : ∑ u ∈ Z.filter (fun u => u = 0), m u ≤ Z3g B 0 := by
      unfold Z3g; simpa using hcount
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this hG00
  -- zeros on the critical line, `|γ| ≤ T₀`
  have hB : ∑ u ∈ (Z.filter fun u => ¬ u = 0).filter (fun u => |u.im| ≤ T0),
      m u * (‖M u‖ * x ^ u.re) ≤ √x * E1g B T0 Q1 Q2 := by
    set S := (Z.filter fun u => ¬ u = 0).filter (fun u => |u.im| ≤ T0) with hS
    have hSZ : S ⊆ Z := (Finset.filter_subset _ _).trans (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
    have hre : ∀ u ∈ S, u.re = 1 / 2 := by
      intro u hu
      obtain ⟨hu1, hu2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hu

      exact hG u hL hr1 hr2 hu2
    have him : ∀ u ∈ S, |u.im| ≤ T0 := fun u hu => (Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2
    have heq : ∀ u ∈ S, m u * (‖M u‖ * x ^ u.re) = √x * (m u * ‖F u.im‖) := by
      intro u hu
      have hu' : u = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + (u.im : ℂ) * I := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [hre u hu]
      rw [hre u hu, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← hMF u.im, ← hu']; ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl heq, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    have hJ := lt_Jl hT00.le
    have hJh : 0 < (Jl T0 : ℝ) * 3.48 := by linarith
    have hZL0 : 0 ≤ ZLg B T0 :=
      div_nonneg (hp.log_pos _).le (log_ratio_pos (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).le
    refine (sum_window_le m (fun u _ => hm u) (h := 3.48) (by norm_num) (Jl T0) hJ him hZL0
      (fun k => count_line_windowG hp hT00.le S hSZ hre him k) hF hF').trans ?_
    unfold E1g
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hZL0
    have hFc : Continuous F := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun t => (hF t).continuousAt
    have e : (Jl T0 : ℝ) * 3.48 - -(Jl T0 * 3.48) = 2 * (Jl T0 * 3.48) := by ring
    have i1 := intervalIntegral_norm_le_sqrt hFc hF2 hQ1 hFQ (a := -(Jl T0 * 3.48))
      (b := Jl T0 * 3.48) (by linarith)
    have i2 := intervalIntegral_norm_le_sqrt hF' hF2' hQ2 hFQ' (a := -(Jl T0 * 3.48))
      (b := Jl T0 * 3.48) (by linarith)
    rw [e] at i1 i2
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left i1 (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3.48)
    linarith
  -- zeros above `T₀`
  have hC : ∑ u ∈ (Z.filter fun u => ¬ u = 0).filter (fun u => ¬ |u.im| ≤ T0),
      m u * (‖M u‖ * x ^ u.re) ≤ x * E2g B κ T0 EB' EA' ρB ρA := by
    set S := (Z.filter fun u => ¬ u = 0).filter (fun u => ¬ |u.im| ≤ T0) with hS
    have hSZ : S ⊆ Z := (Finset.filter_subset _ _).trans (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
    have hre : ∀ u ∈ S, 0 < u.re ∧ u.re < 1 := fun u hu => (hcases u (Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).1).2
    have him : ∀ u ∈ S, T0 < |u.im| := fun u hu => not_le.1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2
    set idx : ℂ → ℕ := fun u => ⌊(|u.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ with hidx
    have hpt : ∀ u ∈ S, m u * (‖M u‖ * x ^ u.re) ≤
        x * (m u * (EB' * ρB ^ idx u) + m u * (EA' * ρA ^ idx u)) := by
      intro u hu
      obtain ⟨hr1, hr2⟩ := hre u hu
      have hGb := htail u hr1 hr2 (him u hu)
      have hxr : x ^ u.re ≤ x := by
        calc x ^ u.re ≤ x ^ (1:ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx hr2.le
          _ = x := Real.rpow_one x
      have hGn := norm_nonneg (M u)
      calc m u * (‖M u‖ * x ^ u.re) ≤ m u * ((EB' * ρB ^ idx u + EA' * ρA ^ idx u) * x) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul hGb hxr (Real.rpow_nonneg hx0.le _) (hGn.trans hGb)) (hm u)
        _ = _ := by ring
    refine (Finset.sum_le_sum hpt).trans ?_
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hx0.le
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    have hZw : ∀ k : ℕ, ∑ u ∈ S.filter (fun u => idx u = k), m u ≤ 2 * Z3g B T0 + 2 * c3g κ T0 * (k + 1) :=
      fun k => count_tail_windowG hp hT00 S hSZ hre him k
    have hZ3 : 0 ≤ Z3g B T0 :=
      div_nonneg (hp.log_pos _).le (log_ratio_pos (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).le

    have g1 := sum_geom_windows m (fun u _ => hm u) idx (Z0 := 2 * Z3g B T0) (c := 2 * c3g κ T0)
      (E := EB') (ρ := ρB) (by linarith) (by linarith) hEB hρB0 hρB1 (fun k => by

theorem fourier_etaU (s : ℝ) :
    𝓕 (fun u => (etaU u : ℂ)) s = ∫ r in Ioi 0, (eta2 r : ℂ) * 𝓕 (fun u => (phiPos u : ℂ)) (r * s) := by
  set F : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun u r => e (-(u * s)) * ((eta2 r * phiPos (u / r) / r : ℝ) : ℂ) with hF
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry F)
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume.restrict (Ioi (0:ℝ)))) := by
    refine (Measurable.mul ?_ ?_).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact (TernaryGoldbach.continuous_e.comp ((continuous_fst.mul continuous_const).neg)).measurable
    · refine Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp ?_
      exact ((TernaryGoldbach.Helfgott.continuous_eta2.measurable.comp measurable_snd).mul
        (measurable_phiPos.comp (measurable_fst.div measurable_snd))).div measurable_snd
  have hnorm : ∀ u, ∀ r, 0 < r → ‖F u r‖ = eta2 r / r * phiPos (u / r) := fun u r hr => by
    simp only [hF, norm_mul, TernaryGoldbach.norm_e, one_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (eta2_nonneg r), abs_of_nonneg (phiPos_nonneg _),
      abs_of_pos hr]; ring
  have hIφ : ∀ r, 0 < r → ∫ u, phiPos (u / r) = r * ∫ u, phiPos u := fun r hr => by
    rw [Measure.integral_comp_div, abs_of_pos hr, smul_eq_mul]
  have hint : Integrable (Function.uncurry F)
      ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod (volume.restrict (Ioi (0:ℝ)))) := by
    rw [integrable_prod_iff' hmeas]
    constructor
    · refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Eventually.of_forall fun r (hr : 0 < r) => ?_)
      refine Integrable.mono' ((integrable_phiPos.comp_div hr.ne').const_mul (eta2 r / r)) ?_
        (Eventually.of_forall fun u => (hnorm u r hr).le)
      refine (Measurable.mul ?_ ?_).aestronglyMeasurable
      · exact (TernaryGoldbach.continuous_e.comp ((continuous_id.mul continuous_const).neg)).measurable
      · exact Complex.measurable_ofReal.comp (show Measurable fun u : ℝ => eta2 r * phiPos (u / r) / r
          from (measurable_const.mul (measurable_phiPos.comp (measurable_id.div_const r))).div_const r)
    · have h : ∀ r ∈ Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ u, ‖Function.uncurry F (u, r)‖ = eta2 r * ∫ u, phiPos u := by

        simp only [Function.uncurry_apply_pair]
        rw [integral_congr_ae (Eventually.of_forall fun u => hnorm u r hr), integral_const_mul,
          hIφ r hr]

  have h1 : 𝓕 (fun u => (etaU u : ℂ)) s = ∫ u, ∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), F u r := by

    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_complex_ofReal]

    rw [← integral_const_mul]; congr 1; ext u; simp only [hF]; push_cast; ring

theorem expδ_mono {T0 δ r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) : expδ T0 (δ * r) ≤ expδ T0 δ := by
  unfold expδ
  by_cases hδ : δ = 0

    rw [if_neg hδr, if_neg hδ, Real.exp_le_exp]

      have : (π * (δ * r)) ^ 2 = (π * δ) ^ 2 * r ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [this]
      have : r ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith

theorem expδ_mono {T0 δ r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) : expδ T0 (δ * r) ≤ expδ T0 δ := by
  unfold expδ
  by_cases hδ : δ = 0
  · simp [hδ]
  · have hδr : δ * r ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hδ hr.ne'
    rw [if_neg hδr, if_neg hδ, Real.exp_le_exp]
    have h1 : (π * (δ * r)) ^ 2 ≤ (π * δ) ^ 2 := by
      have : (π * (δ * r)) ^ 2 = (π * δ) ^ 2 * r ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [this]
      have : r ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
      have : 0 ≤ (π * δ) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      nlinarith
    have h0 : 0 < (π * (δ * r)) ^ 2 := by positivity
    have : T0 ^ 2 / (π * δ) ^ 2 ≤ T0 ^ 2 / (π * (δ * r)) ^ 2 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg _) h0 h1
    rw [mul_div_assoc, mul_div_assoc]
    linarith

theorem integral_eta2_Er_le {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) {T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : 50 ≤ T0) {δ x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ∫ r in Ioi 0, eta2 r * Er q T0 δ x r ≤ err933 q T0 δ x := by
  obtain ⟨hL1, hL2, hL3⟩ := log_nonneg_of hq hT0
  set c0 := T0 * Real.log (q * T0 / (2 * π)) * (6.11 * Real.exp (-0.1598 * T0) + 1.578 * expδ T0 δ) +
      11 * |δ| / x
  set c1 := (1.22 * √T0 * Real.log (q * T0) + 5.056 * √T0 + 1.423 * Real.log q + 37.19) / √x +
      (Real.log q + 6) * (6 * |δ|) / (x * √x)
  set c2 := 3 / x
  set c3 := (Real.log q + 6) / (x * √x)
  have hI0 := integrableOn_eta2_mul (g := fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) continuousOn_const
  have hI1 := integrableOn_eta2_mul (g := fun r => 1 / √r) (contOn_inv_sqrt (by norm_num))
  have hI2 := integrableOn_eta2_mul (g := fun r => 1 / r) (contOn_inv (by norm_num))
  have hI3 := integrableOn_eta2_mul (g := fun r => 1 / (r * √r)) (contOn_inv_mul_sqrt (by norm_num))
  have e : (fun r => eta2 r * Er q T0 δ x r) = fun r =>
      ((c0 * (eta2 r * 1) + c1 * (eta2 r * (1 / √r))) + c2 * (eta2 r * (1 / r))) +
        c3 * (eta2 r * (1 / (r * √r))) := by
    funext r; unfold Er; ring
  have hA : IntegrableOn (fun r => c0 * (eta2 r * 1) + c1 * (eta2 r * (1 / √r))) (Ioi 0) :=
    (hI0.const_mul c0).add (hI1.const_mul c1)
  have hB : IntegrableOn (fun r => c0 * (eta2 r * 1) + c1 * (eta2 r * (1 / √r)) +
      c2 * (eta2 r * (1 / r))) (Ioi 0) := hA.add (hI2.const_mul c2)
  rw [e, integral_add hB (hI3.const_mul c3), integral_add hA (hI2.const_mul c2),
    integral_add (hI0.const_mul c0) (hI1.const_mul c1), integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  simp only [mul_one]
  rw [moment0]
  have m1 := moment_half
  have m2 := moment_one
  have m3 := moment_3half
  have hc1 : 0 ≤ c1 := by positivity
  have hc2 : 0 ≤ c2 := by positivity
  have hc3 : 0 ≤ c3 := by positivity
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left m1 hc1
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left m2 hc2
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left m3 hc3
  have hfin : c0 * 1 + c1 * 1.37259 + c2 * 1.92182 + c3 * 2.74517 = err933 q T0 δ x := by
    simp only [c0, c1, c2, c3]; unfold err933; field_simp; ring
  linarith

theorem err932_le_Er {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) {T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : 50 ≤ T0) {δ x r : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hr1 : r ≤ 1) : err932 q T0 (δ * r) (r * x) ≤ Er q T0 δ x r := by
  obtain ⟨hL1, hL2, hL3⟩ := log_nonneg_of hq hT0
  have hT : 0 ≤ T0 := by linarith
  have h1 : T0 * Real.log (q * T0 / (2 * π)) * (6.11 * Real.exp (-0.1598 * T0) + 1.578 * expδ T0 (δ * r)) ≤
      T0 * Real.log (q * T0 / (2 * π)) * (6.11 * Real.exp (-0.1598 * T0) + 1.578 * expδ T0 δ) := by
    have := expδ_mono (T0 := T0) (δ := δ) hr hr1
    have : 0 ≤ T0 * Real.log (q * T0 / (2 * π)) := mul_nonneg hT hL1
    gcongr
  have hsr : 0 < √r := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hr
  have hsx : 0 < √x := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hx
  have hsrx : √(r * x) = √r * √x := Real.sqrt_mul hr.le x
  have hab : |δ * r| = |δ| * r := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr]
  unfold err932 Er
  rw [hsrx, hab]
  have e : (1.22 * √T0 * Real.log (q * T0) + 5.056 * √T0 + 1.423 * Real.log q + 37.19) / (√r * √x) +
      (3 + 11 * (|δ| * r)) / (r * x) + (Real.log q + 6) * (1 + 6 * (|δ| * r)) / (r * x * (√r * √x)) =
      11 * |δ| / x + ((1.22 * √T0 * Real.log (q * T0) + 5.056 * √T0 + 1.423 * Real.log q + 37.19) / √x +
        (Real.log q + 6) * (6 * |δ|) / (x * √x)) * (1 / √r) +
      3 / x * (1 / r) + (Real.log q + 6) / (x * √x) * (1 / (r * √r)) := by
    have hrr : √r * √r = r := Real.mul_self_sqrt hr.le
    field_simp
    nlinarith [hrr]

theorem rect_identity {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) {φ : ℝ → ℂ} {K c : ℝ} (hφ : GoodSmoothing φ K c) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) {T : ℝ}
    (hT : 0 < T)
    (hbot : ∀ σ ∈ [[(-1 / 2 : ℝ), 3 / 2]], χ.LFunction ((σ : ℂ) + ((-T : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) ≠ 0)
    (htop : ∀ σ ∈ [[(-1 / 2 : ℝ), 3 / 2]], χ.LFunction ((σ : ℂ) + ((T : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) ≠ 0) :
    rectInt (fun s => logDeriv χ.LFunction s * (mellin φ s * (x : ℂ) ^ s)) (zT T) (wT T) =
      2 * π * I * ∑ u ∈ zerosRect χ T, (multRect χ T u : ℂ) * (mellin φ u * (x : ℂ) ^ u) := by
  have hf : Differentiable ℂ χ.LFunction := DirichletCharacter.differentiable_LFunction hχ1
  have hf2 : χ.LFunction 2 ≠ 0 :=
    DirichletCharacter.LFunction_ne_zero_of_one_le_re χ (Or.inl hχ1) (by norm_num)
  have hR : 0 < RT T := by unfold RT; linarith
  have hrect : [[(zT T).re, (wT T).re]] ×ℂ [[(zT T).im, (wT T).im]] ⊆ Metric.ball 2 (RT T / 2) := by
    intro s hs
    rw [mem_reProdIm, zT_re, wT_re, zT_im, wT_im, Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num),
      Set.uIcc_of_le (by linarith)] at hs
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, RT]
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (Complex.norm_le_abs_re_add_abs_im _) ?_
    simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.re_ofNat, Complex.im_ofNat, sub_zero]
    have h1 : |s.re - 2| ≤ 5 / 2 := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [hs.1.1, hs.1.2]
    have h2 : |s.im| ≤ T := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [hs.2.1, hs.2.2]
    linarith
  have hbd : NoZerosOnSides χ.LFunction (zT T) (wT T) := by
    refine ⟨fun σ hσ => ?_, fun σ hσ => ?_, fun y _ => ?_, fun y _ => ?_⟩
    · rw [zT_re, wT_re] at hσ; simpa using hbot σ hσ
    · rw [zT_re, wT_re] at hσ; simpa using htop σ hσ

    · exact LFunction_ne_zero_strip hχ hχ1 (by simp; norm_num) (by simp; norm_num)

where `S = Σ Λ(n) χ(n) e(δn/x) η(n/x)`. (The sum includes the trivial zero `s = 0` when `χ` is even.) -/
theorem explicit_formula_gen {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) {φ : ℝ → ℂ} {K c : ℝ} (hφ : GoodSmoothing φ K c) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ∃ T : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k : ℕ, T k ∈ Icc ((k : ℝ) + 1) ((k : ℝ) + 2)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => ∑ u ∈ zerosRect χ (T k), (multRect χ (T k) u : ℂ) * (mellin φ u * (x : ℂ) ^ u))
        atTop (𝓝 (-SsumG χ φ x - (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) *
          ∫ y : ℝ, hIntG χ φ x (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I))) := by

  have hT' : ∀ k : ℕ, T k ∈ Icc ((k : ℝ) + 1) ((k : ℝ) + 2) := fun k => by
    have := hT k; push_cast at this; constructor <;> linarith [this.1, this.2]
  refine ⟨T, hT', ?_⟩
  have hTpos : ∀ k, 0 < T k := fun k => by linarith [(hT' k).1, (Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0:ℝ) ≤ k)]

  set Linf := ∫ y : ℝ, hIntG χ φ x (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I) with hLinf
  set Sk := fun k => ∑ u ∈ zerosRect χ (T k), (multRect χ (T k) u : ℂ) * (mellin φ u * (x : ℂ) ^ u)
  set Bot := fun k => ∫ σ in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(3 / 2 : ℝ), hIntG χ φ x ((σ : ℂ) + ((-T k : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)
  set Top := fun k => ∫ σ in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(3 / 2 : ℝ), hIntG χ φ x ((σ : ℂ) + ((T k : ℝ) : ℂ) * I)
  set Right := fun k => ∫ y in (-T k)..(T k), hIntG χ φ x (((3 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I)
  set Left := fun k => ∫ y in (-T k)..(T k), hIntG χ φ x (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I)
  -- the rectangle identity, expanded
  have hrect : ∀ k, Bot k - Top k + I * Right k - I * Left k = 2 * π * I * Sk k := by
    intro k
    have h := rect_identity hχ hχ1 hφ hx (hTpos k) (fun σ hσ => ((hgood k σ hσ).1).2)

    rw [← h]

      ‖∫ σ in (-1 / 2 : ℝ)..(3 / 2 : ℝ), hIntG χ φ x ((σ : ℂ) + (S : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤
        Hk N (k + 1) * Real.exp (-(c * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) * (K * (x ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) + x ^ (-1 / 2 : ℝ))) *
          |(3 / 2 : ℝ) - (-1 / 2)| := by
    intro k S hS
    refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const fun σ hσ => ?_
    have hσ' : σ ∈ [[(-1 / 2 : ℝ), 3 / 2]] := Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hσ
    have hσ2 : -1 / 2 ≤ σ ∧ σ ≤ 3 / 2 := by
      rw [Set.uIcc_of_le (by norm_num)] at hσ'; exact hσ'
    have hb : ‖logDeriv χ.LFunction ((σ : ℂ) + (S : ℂ) * I)‖ ≤ Hk N (k + 1) := by
      rcases hS with rfl | rfl
      · exact ((hgood k σ hσ').2).1
      · exact ((hgood k σ hσ').2).2
    have hS' : |S| = T k := by
      rcases hS with rfl | rfl
      · exact abs_of_pos (hTpos k)
      · rw [abs_neg]; exact abs_of_pos (hTpos k)
    have hG := hφ.strip ((σ : ℂ) + (S : ℂ) * I) (by simp; linarith) (by simp; linarith)
    have him : ((σ : ℂ) + (S : ℂ) * I).im = S := by simp
    have hre : ((σ : ℂ) + (S : ℂ) * I).re = σ := by simp
    rw [him, hS'] at hG
    have hexp : Real.exp (-(c * T k)) ≤ Real.exp (-(c * ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) := by
      refine Real.exp_le_exp.2 ?_
      have := (hT' k).1; push_cast; nlinarith [hφ.c_pos]
    have hK : 0 ≤ K := hφ.K_nonneg
    have hxσ := rpow_le_of_mem hx hσ2.1 hσ2.2
    have hHk0 : 0 ≤ Hk N (k + 1) := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) hb
    rw [hIntG, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_cpow_x hx, hre]

theorem logDeriv_L_near {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) {T : ℝ} {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ closedBall (2 + T * I) (10 / 4))
    (hLz : χ.LFunction z ≠ 0) :

        ((divB χ.LFunction (2 + T * I) 10 u).toNat : ℂ) / (z - u)‖ ≤
      4.8 * Real.log (BT N T / 0.355) := by
  have hc := norm_L_center_ge χ T
  have hc0 : χ.LFunction (2 + T * I) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [h, norm_zero] at hc; norm_num at hc
  have hB := one_le_BT (N := N) T
  have hcB : ‖χ.LFunction (2 + T * I)‖ < BT N T := by
    have := norm_LFunction_two_le χ (s := 2 + T * I) (by simp)
    have hpi := Real.pi_lt_d2
    nlinarith [Real.pi_pos]
  have h := landau (DirichletCharacter.differentiable_LFunction hχ1) hc0 (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 10)

  have hle : Real.log (BT N T / ‖χ.LFunction (2 + T * I)‖) ≤ Real.log (BT N T / 0.355) :=

/-- `|L(s, χ) − 1| ≤ ζ(2) − 1` on `ℜs = 2`, so `|L(s, χ)| ≥ 2 − π²/6`. -/
theorem norm_LFunction_two_ge (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) {s : ℂ} (hs : s.re = 2) :
    2 - π ^ 2 / 6 ≤ ‖χ.LFunction s‖ := by
  have hs1 : 1 < s.re := by rw [hs]; norm_num
  rw [DirichletCharacter.LFunction_eq_LSeries χ hs1, LSeries]
  have hsum := χ.LSeriesSummable_of_one_lt_re hs1
  rw [hsum.tsum_eq_add_tsum_ite 1]
  have h1 : LSeries.term (fun n => χ (n : ZMod q)) s 1 = 1 := by
    simp [LSeries.term]
  rw [h1]
  set c : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => if n = 1 then 0 else 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2
  have hc : HasSum c (π ^ 2 / 6 - 1) := by
    have h := hasSum_zeta_two
    have h' := h.summable.tsum_eq_add_tsum_ite 1
    rw [h.tsum_eq] at h'
    have : ∑' n, c n = π ^ 2 / 6 - 1 := by simp only [c]; norm_num at h' ⊢; linarith
    rw [← this]
    exact (h.summable.congr_cofinite (by
      filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_cofinite_ne 1] with n hn
      simp [c, hn])).hasSum
  have hb : ‖∑' n, (if n = 1 then 0 else LSeries.term (fun n => χ (n : ZMod q)) s n)‖ ≤
      π ^ 2 / 6 - 1 := by
    refine tsum_of_norm_bounded hc fun n => ?_
    by_cases hn : n = 1
    · simp [c, hn]
    · simp only [c, hn, ite_false]
      rw [LSeries.norm_term_eq]
      split_ifs with h0
      · simp [h0]
      · rw [hs]
        have hn0 : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0
        have : ‖χ (n : ZMod q)‖ ≤ 1 := DirichletCharacter.norm_le_one _ _
        rw [Real.rpow_two]
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right this (by positivity)
  have := norm_sub_norm_le (1 : ℂ) (-(∑' n, (if n = 1 then 0 else
    LSeries.term (fun n => χ (n : ZMod q)) s n)))
  rw [norm_one, norm_neg, sub_neg_eq_add] at this
  linarith

theorem LFunction_eq_mul_Iint {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q} (hχ : χ ≠ 1) {s : ℂ} (hs : 0 < s.re) :
    χ.LFunction s = s * Iint χ s := by
  set U := {s : ℂ | 0 < s.re}
  have hUo : IsOpen U := isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re
  have hUc : IsPreconnected U := (convex_halfSpace_re_gt 0).isPreconnected
  have hf : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ χ.LFunction U := fun z _ =>
    (DirichletCharacter.differentiable_LFunction hχ).analyticAt z
  have hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (fun s => s * Iint χ s) U :=
    (differentiableOn_mul_Iint hχ).analyticOnNhd hUo
  have h2 : (2 : ℂ) ∈ U := by show (0:ℝ) < (2:ℂ).re; norm_num
  have hev : χ.LFunction =ᶠ[nhds (2 : ℂ)] fun s => s * Iint χ s := by
    have hopen : {s : ℂ | 1 < s.re} ∈ nhds (2 : ℂ) :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const Complex.continuous_re).mem_nhds (by show (1:ℝ) < (2:ℂ).re; norm_num)
    filter_upwards [hopen] with s hs1
    rw [DirichletCharacter.LFunction_eq_LSeries χ hs1]
    have hO : (fun n : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ Icc 1 n, χ (k : ZMod q)) =O[atTop] fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ (0 : ℝ) := by
      refine Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound ((q : ℝ) + 1) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => ?_)
      simp only [Real.rpow_zero, norm_one, mul_one]
      exact norm_psum_le hχ n
    exact LSeries_eq_mul_integral _ le_rfl (by linarith) (χ.LSeriesSummable_of_one_lt_re hs1) hO
  exact hf.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq hg hUc h2 hev hs

/-- **Cauchy–Schwarz on an interval** (via AM–GM): `∫_a^b |g| ≤ √(A(b − a))` if `∫ |g|² ≤ A`. -/
theorem intervalIntegral_norm_le_sqrt {g : ℝ → ℂ} (hg : Continuous g)
    (hg2 : Integrable fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2) {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hgA : ∫ t, ‖g t‖ ^ 2 ≤ A)
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) :
    ∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ≤ √(A * (b - a)) := by
  set L := b - a with hL
  have hL0 : 0 < L := by rw [hL]; linarith
  set s := √(A * L) with hs
  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = A * L := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  set c := s / L with hc
  have hc0 : 0 < c := by positivity
  have hpt : ∀ t, ‖g t‖ ≤ ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2 := by
    intro t
    rw [div_add_div _ _ (by positivity) (by norm_num), le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖g t‖ - c)]
  have hgc := hg
  have i1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c)) volume a b :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have i2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2) volume a b :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have h1 : ∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ≤ ∫ t in a..b, (‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab.le (hg.norm.intervalIntegrable _ _) i2 fun t _ => hpt t
  have h2 : ∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ^ 2 ≤ A := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le]
    exact (setIntegral_le_integral hg2 (Eventually.of_forall fun t => by positivity)).trans hgA
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add i1 intervalIntegrable_const, intervalIntegral.integral_div, intervalIntegral.integral_const,
    smul_eq_mul] at h1
  have h3 : (∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ^ 2) / (2 * c) ≤ A / (2 * c) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h2 (by positivity)
  have h4 : A / (2 * c) + (b - a) * (c / 2) = s := by
    rw [← hL, hc]; field_simp; nlinarith [hs2]
  linarith

/-- **Mellin–Plancherel**: `∫ |G_δ(1/2 + it)|² dt = 2π ∫₀^∞ (u² e^{−u²/2})² du`. -/
theorem integral_norm_sq_G_half (δ : ℝ) :
    ∫ t : ℝ, ‖Gr (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I) δ 0‖ ^ 2 =
      2 * π * ∫ u in Ioi (0:ℝ), (u ^ 2 * Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 2)) ^ 2 := by
  simp_rw [G_half_eq_fourier]
  have h1 := Measure.integral_comp_div (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖𝓕 (Fhalf δ) ξ‖ ^ 2) (2 * π)
  rw [h1, abs_of_pos (by positivity), smul_eq_mul,
    TernaryGoldbach.integral_norm_sq_fourier (integrable_Fhalf δ) (memLp_Fhalf δ)]
  congr 1
  -- `∫ e^{−u} |fδ(e^{−u})|² du = ∫₀^∞ |fδ|²` via `mellin_eq_fourier` at `s = 1`
  set g : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => (((v ^ 2 * Real.exp (-v ^ 2 / 2)) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) with hg
  have hm := mellin_eq_fourier g (s := (1 : ℂ))
  simp only [Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im, zero_div] at hm
  rw [Real.fourier_eq] at hm
  simp only [inner_zero_right, neg_zero, Real.fourierChar_apply, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero,
    zero_mul, Complex.exp_zero, Circle.smul_def] at hm
  simp only [one_smul] at hm
  rw [mellin] at hm
  have hL : ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), (t : ℂ) ^ ((1:ℂ) - 1) • g t =
      ((∫ u in Ioi (0:ℝ), (u ^ 2 * Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 2)) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simp only [sub_self, Complex.cpow_zero, one_smul, hg]; exact integral_ofReal
  have hpt : ∀ v : ℝ, Real.exp (-1 * v) • g (Real.exp (-v)) = ((‖Fhalf δ v‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro v
    rw [Complex.real_smul, hg, ← Complex.ofReal_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [norm_Fhalf]
    have h5 : Real.exp (-(5 / 2) * v) ^ 2 = Real.exp (-v) ^ 5 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
    have h1 : Real.exp (-1 * v) = Real.exp (-v) := by ring_nf
    rw [h1, mul_pow (Real.exp (-(5 / 2) * v)), h5]
    ring
  have hR : ∫ v, Real.exp (-1 * v) • g (Real.exp (-v)) = ((∫ x, ‖Fhalf δ x‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simp_rw [hpt]; exact integral_ofReal
  rw [hL, hR] at hm
  exact_mod_cast hm.symm

theorem intervalIntegral_norm_le_sqrt {g : ℝ → ℂ} (hg : Continuous g)
    (hg2 : Integrable fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2) {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hgA : ∫ t, ‖g t‖ ^ 2 ≤ A)
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) :
    ∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ≤ √(A * (b - a)) := by
  set L := b - a with hL
  have hL0 : 0 < L := by rw [hL]; linarith
  set s := √(A * L) with hs
  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = A * L := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  set c := s / L with hc
  have hc0 : 0 < c := by positivity
  have hpt : ∀ t, ‖g t‖ ≤ ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2 := by
    intro t
    rw [div_add_div _ _ (by positivity) (by norm_num), le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖g t‖ - c)]
  have hgc := hg
  have i1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c)) volume a b :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have i2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2) volume a b :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have h1 : ∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ≤ ∫ t in a..b, (‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab.le (hg.norm.intervalIntegrable _ _) i2 fun t _ => hpt t
  have h2 : ∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ^ 2 ≤ A := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le]
    exact (setIntegral_le_integral hg2 (Eventually.of_forall fun t => by positivity)).trans hgA
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add i1 intervalIntegrable_const, intervalIntegral.integral_div, intervalIntegral.integral_const,
    smul_eq_mul] at h1
  have h3 : (∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ^ 2) / (2 * c) ≤ A / (2 * c) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h2 (by positivity)
  have h4 : A / (2 * c) + (b - a) * (c / 2) = s := by
    rw [← hL, hc]; field_simp; nlinarith [hs2]
  linarith

theorem hasDerivAt_fline (δ t : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fline δ) (flineD δ t) t := by

theorem integral_norm_sq_flineD (δ : ℝ) :
    ∫ t, ‖flineD δ t‖ ^ 2 = 2 * π * ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), Real.log v ^ 2 * etaSq v := by
  have hpi : 0 < 2 * π := by positivity
  have e1 : ∀ t, ‖flineD δ t‖ ^ 2 = (1 / (2 * π)) ^ 2 * ‖𝓕 (FhalfD δ) (t / (2 * π))‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro t
    rw [flineD, norm_smul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
  simp_rw [e1]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  have h1 := Measure.integral_comp_div (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖𝓕 (FhalfD δ) ξ‖ ^ 2) (2 * π)
  rw [h1, abs_of_pos hpi, smul_eq_mul, TernaryGoldbach.integral_norm_sq_fourier
    (integrable_memLp_FhalfD δ).1 (integrable_memLp_FhalfD δ).2]
  have e2 : ∀ x, ‖FhalfD δ x‖ ^ 2 = (2 * π) ^ 2 * (x ^ 2 * ‖Fhalf δ x‖ ^ 2) := by
    intro x
    have e : FhalfD δ x = (-2 * π * I) * (x • Fhalf δ x) := by
      rw [FhalfD, smul_eq_mul, Complex.real_smul]; ring
    rw [e, norm_mul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have : ‖-2 * π * I‖ = 2 * π := by
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_I, mul_one, norm_neg, Complex.norm_ofNat, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
    rw [this, mul_pow, mul_pow (|x|), sq_abs]
  simp_rw [e2]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_sq_mul_norm_sq_Fhalf]
  field_simp

theorem sum_window_fline_le {S : Finset ℂ} (m : ℂ → ℝ) (hm : ∀ u ∈ S, 0 ≤ m u) {h T0 Z : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (hT0 : 0 ≤ T0) (J : ℕ) (hJ : T0 < J * h) (hS : ∀ u ∈ S, |u.im| ≤ T0) (hZ0 : 0 ≤ Z)
    (hZ : ∀ k : ℕ, ∑ u ∈ S.filter (fun u => (⌊u.im / h⌋ + J).toNat = k), m u ≤ Z) (δ : ℝ) :
    ∑ u ∈ S, m u * ‖fline δ u.im‖ ≤
      Z * ((1 / h) * √(2 * π * 0.6647 * (2 * (J * h))) + √(2 * π * 0.1707 * (2 * (J * h)))) := by

    (by positivity) (integral_norm_sq_flineD_le δ) (a := -(J * h)) (b := J * h) (by linarith)
  rw [e] at h1 h2
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / h)
  linarith

/-- **Tail window count**: rectangle zeros with `0 < ℜu < 1` and `⌊(|ℑu| − T₀)/4.4⌋ = k` have total
multiplicity `≤ 2 Z₃ + 2 c₃ (k + 1)`. -/
theorem count_tail_window {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) {T T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : 0 < T0) (S : Finset ℂ) (hS : S ⊆ zerosRect χ T)
    (hre : ∀ u ∈ S, 0 < u.re ∧ u.re < 1) (him : ∀ u ∈ S, T0 < |u.im|) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ u ∈ S.filter (fun u => ⌊(|u.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ = k), (multRect χ T u : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Z3 N T0 + 2 * c3 T0 * (k + 1) := by
  set F := S.filter (fun u => ⌊(|u.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ = k) with hF
  set c := T0 + ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * 4.4 with hc
  have hL3 := log_ratio_pos (r := 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  -- window position
  have hpos : ∀ u ∈ F, (k : ℝ) * 4.4 ≤ |u.im| - T0 ∧ |u.im| - T0 < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * 4.4 := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨huS, hk⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hu
    have h0 : 0 ≤ (|u.im| - T0) / 4.4 := div_nonneg (by linarith [him u huS]) (by norm_num)
    have h1 := Nat.floor_le h0
    have h2 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one ((|u.im| - T0) / 4.4)
    rw [hk] at h1 h2
    constructor
    · rwa [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)] at h1
    · rwa [div_lt_iff₀ (by norm_num)] at h2
  have hcount : ∀ (F' : Finset ℂ), F' ⊆ F → ∀ c' : ℝ, |c'| = c →
      (∀ u ∈ F', ‖u - (2 + c' * I)‖ ≤ 3) → ∑ u ∈ F', (multRect χ T u : ℝ) ≤ Z3 N T0 + c3 T0 * (k + 1) := by
    intro F' hF' c' hc' hball
    have h1 := sum_multRect_le hχ hχ1 F' ((hF'.trans (Finset.filter_subset _ _)).trans hS) c'
      (r := 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hball
    have h2 : Real.log (BP N c' / 0.355) ≤ Real.log (BP N T0 / 0.355) + 11 * (((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * 4.4) / T0 := by
      have e : BP N c' = BP N (T0 + ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * 4.4) := by
        unfold BP; rw [hc', hc, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < T0 + ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * 4.4)]

      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hT0]; nlinarith
    refine h1.trans ?_
    unfold Z3 c3
    rw [div_add' _ _ _ hL3.ne', div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hL3]
    rw [show 11 * 4.4 / T0 / Real.log (10 / 3) * ((k : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log (10 / 3) = 11 * 4.4 / T0 * (k + 1) by
      field_simp]
    linarith
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not F (fun u => 0 < u.im)]
  have hp := hcount (F.filter fun u => 0 < u.im) (Finset.filter_subset _ _) c
    (abs_of_pos (by positivity)) (fun u hu => by
      obtain ⟨huF, him0⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hu
      obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hpos u huF
      obtain ⟨hr1, hr2⟩ := hre u (Finset.mem_filter.1 huF).1
      rw [abs_of_pos him0] at hp1 hp2
      refine norm_le_of_re_im (a := 2) (b := 2.2) (by norm_num) ?_ ?_ (by norm_num)
      · simp only [Complex.sub_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.re_ofNat, Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
          Complex.I_re, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im, mul_one, sub_zero]
        rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith
      · simp only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.add_im, Complex.im_ofNat, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
          Complex.I_re, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_im, mul_one, zero_add]
        rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith)
  have hn := hcount (F.filter fun u => ¬ 0 < u.im) (Finset.filter_subset _ _) (-c)
    (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]) (fun u hu => by
      obtain ⟨huF, him0⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hu
      obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hpos u huF
      obtain ⟨hr1, hr2⟩ := hre u (Finset.mem_filter.1 huF).1

        rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith)
  linarith

/-- **The sum over zeros** (generic). -/
theorem zero_sum_boundG (hp : PolyDatum f B κ)
    (hcls : ∀ T : ℝ, ∀ u ∈ zerosRectD f T, f u = 0 ∧ (u = 0 ∨ (0 < u.re ∧ u.re < 1)))
    {T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : 50 ≤ T0)
    (hG : ∀ ρ : ℂ, f ρ = 0 → 0 < ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 → |ρ.im| ≤ T0 → ρ.re = 1 / 2)
    (M : ℂ → ℂ) {G0 : ℝ} (hM0 : ‖M 0‖ ≤ G0)
    {F F' : ℝ → ℂ} (hMF : ∀ t : ℝ, M (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I) = F t)
    (hF : ∀ t, HasDerivAt F (F' t) t) (hF' : Continuous F')
    {Q1 Q2 : ℝ} (hQ1 : 0 < Q1) (hQ2 : 0 < Q2)
    (hF2 : Integrable fun t => ‖F t‖ ^ 2) (hF2' : Integrable fun t => ‖F' t‖ ^ 2)
    (hFQ : ∫ t, ‖F t‖ ^ 2 ≤ Q1) (hFQ' : ∫ t, ‖F' t‖ ^ 2 ≤ Q2)
    {EB' EA' ρB ρA : ℝ} (hEB : 0 ≤ EB') (hEA : 0 ≤ EA') (hρB0 : 0 ≤ ρB) (hρB1 : ρB < 1)
    (hρA0 : 0 ≤ ρA) (hρA1 : ρA < 1)
    (htail : ∀ s : ℂ, 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → T0 < |s.im| →
      ‖M s‖ ≤ EB' * ρB ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ + EA' * ρA ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (T : ℝ) :
    ‖∑ u ∈ zerosRectD f T, (multRectD f T u : ℂ) * (M u * (x : ℂ) ^ u)‖ ≤
      G0 * Z3g B 0 + √x * E1g B T0 Q1 Q2 + x * E2g B κ T0 EB' EA' ρB ρA := by
  set Z := zerosRectD f T with hZ
  set m : ℂ → ℝ := fun u => (multRectD f T u : ℝ) with hmdef
  have hm : ∀ u, 0 ≤ m u := fun u => Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hT00 : 0 < T0 := by linarith
  have h1 : ‖∑ u ∈ Z, (multRectD f T u : ℂ) * (M u * (x : ℂ) ^ u)‖ ≤
      ∑ u ∈ Z, m u * (‖M u‖ * x ^ u.re) := by
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun u _ => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, norm_cpow_x hx0]
  refine h1.trans ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Z (fun u => u = 0),
    ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (Z.filter fun u => ¬ u = 0) (fun u => |u.im| ≤ T0)]
  have hcases : ∀ u ∈ Z.filter (fun u => ¬ u = 0), f u = 0 ∧ 0 < u.re ∧ u.re < 1 := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨huZ, hu0⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hu
    obtain ⟨hL, hc⟩ := hcls T u huZ
    rcases hc with h | h
    · exact absurd h hu0
    · exact ⟨hL, h⟩
  have hG00 : 0 ≤ G0 := (norm_nonneg _).trans hM0
  -- the zero at `0`
  have hA : ∑ u ∈ Z.filter (fun u => u = 0), m u * (‖M u‖ * x ^ u.re) ≤ G0 * Z3g B 0 := by
    have hcount := sum_multRectD_le hp (Z.filter fun u => u = 0) (Finset.filter_subset _ _) 0
      (r := 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (fun u hu => by
        rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2]; norm_num)
    have hpt : ∀ u ∈ Z.filter (fun u => u = 0), m u * (‖M u‖ * x ^ u.re) ≤ m u * G0 := by
      intro u hu
      rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2, Complex.zero_re, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]

    (hF2 : Integrable fun t => ‖F t‖ ^ 2) (hF2' : Integrable fun t => ‖F' t‖ ^ 2)

      ‖mellin φ s‖ ≤ EB' * ρB ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ + EA' * ρA ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊)

    have hB : TernaryGoldbach.MinorArcs.Bset q = (range q).filter q.Coprime := by
      unfold TernaryGoldbach.MinorArcs.Bset

    have hsum : ∑ b ∈ TernaryGoldbach.MinorArcs.Bset q, e (-(N * ((b : ℝ) / q))) =
        (starRingEnd ℂ) (∑ a ∈ (range q).filter q.Coprime, e (a * N / q)) := by

theorem mPhi_two_mul (q : ℕ) : mPhi (2 * q) = if Odd q then mPhi q else 0 := by

    have hsq : Squarefree (2 * q) ↔ Squarefree q := by
      rw [Nat.squarefree_mul hcop]; simp [Nat.squarefree_two]
    unfold mPhi
    rw [Nat.totient_mul hcop, Nat.totient_two, one_mul]
    simp only [hsq]
  · have he : Even q := Nat.not_odd_iff_even.1 ho
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := he
    have hns : ¬Squarefree (2 * (k + k)) := by
      intro hs
      have h4 : 2 * 2 ∣ 2 * (k + k) := ⟨k, by ring⟩
      have := hs 2 h4
      norm_num at this
    unfold mPhi; rw [if_neg hns, zero_div]

theorem hfun_antitone {z₁ z₂ : ℝ} (h9 : rexp 9 ≤ z₁) (h12 : z₁ ≤ z₂) : hfun z₂ ≤ hfun z₁ := by
  have hz₁ : 0 < z₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 9) h9
  have hz₂ : 0 < z₂ := by linarith
  have hs₁ : 9 ≤ Real.log z₁ := by rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hz₁]; exact h9
  have hs12 := Real.log_le_log hz₁ h12
  have hrp : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → ∀ p : ℝ, z ^ p = rexp (p * Real.log z) := fun z hz p => by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hz, mul_comm]
  -- first term
  have hA := antitoneOn_mul_exp_neg (Q := fun s => s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ))
    (Q' := fun s => 3 / 2 * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (s₁ := 9) (s₂ := Real.log z₂) (p := 1 / 6)
    (fun s hs => by
      have := Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (x := s) (p := 3 / 2) (Or.inl (by linarith [hs.1]))
      convert this using 2; norm_num)
    (fun s hs => by
      have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith [hs.1]
      have e : s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = s * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_one_add' hs0.le (by norm_num)]; norm_num
      rw [e]
      have : 0 ≤ s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
      nlinarith [hs.1])
  have hB := antitoneOn_mul_exp_neg (Q := fun s => s) (Q' := fun _ => 1) (s₁ := 9)
    (s₂ := Real.log z₂) (p := 1 / 3) (fun s _ => hasDerivAt_id s) (fun s hs => by
      linarith [hs.1])
  have m1 : Real.log z₁ ∈ Icc 9 (Real.log z₂) := ⟨hs₁, hs12⟩
  have m2 : Real.log z₂ ∈ Icc 9 (Real.log z₂) := ⟨hs₁.trans hs12, le_rfl⟩
  have h1 := hA m1 m2 hs12
  have h2 := hB m1 m2 hs12
  simp only at h1 h2
  unfold hfun
  rw [hrp z₁ hz₁, hrp z₂ hz₂, hrp z₁ hz₁ (-1 / 3), hrp z₂ hz₂ (-1 / 3)]
  have e1 : ∀ s : ℝ, rexp (-1 / 6 * s) = rexp (-(1 / 6) * s) := fun s => by ring_nf
  have e2 : ∀ s : ℝ, rexp (-1 / 3 * s) = rexp (-(1 / 3) * s) := fun s => by ring_nf
  rw [e1, e1, e2, e2]
  nlinarith

/-- **Prop 11.2.3′.** Let `y = x/κ`, `α ∉ 𝔐_{8,n}(y)`, `0 < w₀ ≤ 1 ≤ w₁`, `w₀y ≥ 2.16·10²⁰`,

`z = wy`, `G(w) ≥ g_z(min(1, w) n)` whenever `min(1, w) n ≤ z^{1/3}/6`, and
`G(w) z ≥ 0.276 z^{5/6} (log z)^{3/2} + 1234 z^{2/3} log z`. Then
`|S_{η_*}(α, x)| ≤ y (∫_{w₀}^{w₁} Gφ + 17 (∫_0^{w₀} φ + ∫_{w₁}^∞ φ))`. -/

    (hα : α ∉ majorArcs 8 n (x / κ)) (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) (hw₀1 : w₀ ≤ 1) (hw₁ : 1 ≤ w₁)
    (hy : 2.16e20 ≤ w₀ * (x / κ)) (hn : 670 ≤ w₀ * n)
    (hG1 : ∀ w ∈ Icc w₀ w₁, min 1 w * n ≤ (w * (x / κ)) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6 →
      gx (w * (x / κ)) (min 1 w * n) ≤ G w)
    (hG2 : ∀ w ∈ Icc w₀ w₁, 0.276 * (w * (x / κ)) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * (x / κ)) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) +
      1234 * (w * (x / κ)) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * (x / κ)) ≤ G w * (w * (x / κ)))
    (hGi : IntegrableOn (fun w => G w * phi w) (Icc w₀ w₁)) :
    ‖S etaStar x α‖ ≤ x / κ * ((∫ w in Icc w₀ w₁, G w * phi w) +
      17 * ((∫ w in Ioo 0 w₀, phi w) + ∫ w in Ioi w₁, phi w)) := by

  refine norm_S_eta2_le_of_not_mem hy0 hα hw0

theorem hfun_antitone {z₁ z₂ : ℝ} (h9 : rexp 9 ≤ z₁) (h12 : z₁ ≤ z₂) : hfun z₂ ≤ hfun z₁ := by
  have hz₁ : 0 < z₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 9) h9
  have hz₂ : 0 < z₂ := by linarith
  have hs₁ : 9 ≤ Real.log z₁ := by rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hz₁]; exact h9
  have hs12 := Real.log_le_log hz₁ h12
  have hrp : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → ∀ p : ℝ, z ^ p = rexp (p * Real.log z) := fun z hz p => by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hz, mul_comm]
  -- first term
  have hA := antitoneOn_mul_exp_neg (Q := fun s => s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ))
    (Q' := fun s => 3 / 2 * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (s₁ := 9) (s₂ := Real.log z₂) (p := 1 / 6)
    (fun s hs => by
      have := Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (x := s) (p := 3 / 2) (Or.inl (by linarith [hs.1]))
      convert this using 2; norm_num)
    (fun s hs => by
      have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith [hs.1]
      have e : s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = s * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_one_add' hs0.le (by norm_num)]; norm_num
      rw [e]
      have : 0 ≤ s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
      nlinarith [hs.1])
  have hB := antitoneOn_mul_exp_neg (Q := fun s => s) (Q' := fun _ => 1) (s₁ := 9)
    (s₂ := Real.log z₂) (p := 1 / 3) (fun s _ => hasDerivAt_id s) (fun s hs => by
      linarith [hs.1])
  have m1 : Real.log z₁ ∈ Icc 9 (Real.log z₂) := ⟨hs₁, hs12⟩
  have m2 : Real.log z₂ ∈ Icc 9 (Real.log z₂) := ⟨hs₁.trans hs12, le_rfl⟩
  have h1 := hA m1 m2 hs12
  have h2 := hB m1 m2 hs12
  simp only at h1 h2
  unfold hfun
  rw [hrp z₁ hz₁, hrp z₂ hz₂, hrp z₁ hz₁ (-1 / 3), hrp z₂ hz₂ (-1 / 3)]
  have e1 : ∀ s : ℝ, rexp (-1 / 6 * s) = rexp (-(1 / 6) * s) := fun s => by ring_nf
  have e2 : ∀ s : ℝ, rexp (-1 / 3 * s) = rexp (-(1 / 3) * s) := fun s => by ring_nf
  rw [e1, e1, e2, e2]
  nlinarith

/-- If `Q' ≤ p Q` on `[s₁, s₂]`, then `s ↦ Q(s) e^{-ps}` is antitone there. -/
theorem antitoneOn_mul_exp_neg {Q Q' : ℝ → ℝ} {s₁ s₂ p : ℝ}
    (hd : ∀ s ∈ Icc s₁ s₂, HasDerivAt Q (Q' s) s) (hle : ∀ s ∈ Icc s₁ s₂, Q' s ≤ p * Q s) :
    AntitoneOn (fun s => Q s * rexp (-p * s)) (Icc s₁ s₂) := by
  have hD : ∀ s ∈ Icc s₁ s₂, HasDerivAt (fun s => Q s * rexp (-p * s))
      (Q' s * rexp (-p * s) + Q s * (rexp (-p * s) * (-p))) s := by
    intro s hs
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s => -p * s) (-p) s := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul (-p)
    exact (hd s hs).mul h1.exp
  refine antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Icc _ _)
    (fun s hs => (hD s hs).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun s hs => (hD s (interior_subset hs)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt) fun s hs => ?_
  rw [(hD s (interior_subset hs)).deriv]
  have := hle s (interior_subset hs)
  have he := (Real.exp_pos (-p * s)).le
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 this) he]

theorem antitoneOn_mul_exp_neg {Q Q' : ℝ → ℝ} {s₁ s₂ p : ℝ}
    (hd : ∀ s ∈ Icc s₁ s₂, HasDerivAt Q (Q' s) s) (hle : ∀ s ∈ Icc s₁ s₂, Q' s ≤ p * Q s) :
    AntitoneOn (fun s => Q s * rexp (-p * s)) (Icc s₁ s₂) := by
  have hD : ∀ s ∈ Icc s₁ s₂, HasDerivAt (fun s => Q s * rexp (-p * s))
      (Q' s * rexp (-p * s) + Q s * (rexp (-p * s) * (-p))) s := by
    intro s hs
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s => -p * s) (-p) s := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul (-p)
    exact (hd s hs).mul h1.exp
  refine antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Icc _ _)
    (fun s hs => (hD s hs).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun s hs => (hD s (interior_subset hs)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt) fun s hs => ?_
  rw [(hD s (interior_subset hs)).deriv]
  have := hle s (interior_subset hs)
  have he := (Real.exp_pos (-p * s)).le
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 this) he]

/-- [H, (11.9)]: `S_{η_*}(α, x) = ∫₀^∞ S_{η₂}(α, w y) φ(w) dw/w` with `y = x/κ`. -/
theorem S_etaStar_eq {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (α : ℝ) :
    S etaStar x α = ∫ w in Ioi (0:ℝ), S eta2 (w * (x / κ)) α * ((phi w / w : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  have hκ : (0 : ℝ) < κ := by rw [κ]; norm_num
  set y := x / κ with hy_def
  have hy : 0 < y := div_pos hx hκ
  set F : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun n w =>
    ((Λ n * eta2 (n / (w * y)) * (phi w / w) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α) with hF
  have hphiw : ∀ w, 0 < w → phi w / w = w * Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * w ^ 2) := by
    intro w hw
    unfold phi
    field_simp
  -- `η_*(n/x)` as a `w`-integral
  have hstar : ∀ n : ℕ, etaStar (n / x) = ∫ w in Ioi (0:ℝ), eta2 (n / (w * y)) * (phi w / w) := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_div]
      unfold etaStar mellinConv
      simp only [mul_zero, zero_div]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun w _ => ?_
      have h1 : phi 0 = 0 := by simp [phi]
      have h2 : eta2 0 = 0 := by simp [eta2]
      simp [h1, h2]
    · unfold etaStar
      rw [mellinConv_eq_swap _ _ (by positivity)]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun w (hw : 0 < w) => ?_
      rw [mul_div_assoc]
      congr 2
      rw [hy_def]
      field_simp
  have hstar0 : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ etaStar (n / x) := by
    intro n
    rw [hstar n]
    refine setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Ioi fun w (hw : 0 < w) => ?_
    have : 0 ≤ phi w := by unfold phi; positivity
    exact mul_nonneg (eta2_nonneg _) (div_nonneg this hw.le)
  -- measurability and domination
  have hmeas : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable fun w : ℝ => eta2 (n / (w * y)) * (phi w / w) := by
    intro n
    have hphi : Continuous phi := by unfold phi; fun_prop
    exact (continuous_eta2.measurable.comp (measurable_const.div (measurable_id.mul_const y))).mul
      (hphi.measurable.div measurable_id)
  have hgauss : IntegrableOn (fun w : ℝ => w * Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * w ^ 2)) (Ioi 0) :=
    (integrable_mul_exp_neg_mul_sq (b := 1 / 2) (by norm_num)).integrableOn
  have hint_real : ∀ n : ℕ,
      IntegrableOn (fun w : ℝ => eta2 (n / (w * y)) * (phi w / w)) (Ioi 0) := by
    intro n
    refine Integrable.mono' (hgauss.const_mul 3) (hmeas n).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun w (hw : 0 < w) => ?_)
    rw [hphiw w hw, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (eta2_nonneg _),
      abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (eta2_le _) (by positivity)
  have hFint : ∀ n, Integrable (F n) (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) := by
    intro n
    have : Integrable (fun w : ℝ => ((Λ n * (eta2 (n / (w * y)) * (phi w / w)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) := ((hint_real n).const_mul (Λ n)).ofReal
    refine (this.mul_const (TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α))).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun w => ?_)
    simp only [F, mul_assoc]
  have hFn : ∀ n, ∫ w in Ioi (0:ℝ), F n w =
      ((Λ n * etaStar (n / x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α) := by
    intro n
    simp only [F]
    rw [integral_mul_const, integral_complex_ofReal, hstar n, ← integral_const_mul]
    congr 3
    funext w
    ring
  have hFnorm : ∀ n, ∫ w in Ioi (0:ℝ), ‖F n w‖ = ‖((Λ n * etaStar (n / x) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ := by
    intro n
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (hstar0 n)), hstar n,
      ← integral_const_mul]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun w (hw : 0 < w) => ?_
    have : 0 ≤ phi w := by unfold phi; positivity
    simp only [F, norm_mul, norm_e, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg, abs_of_nonneg (eta2_nonneg _),
      abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg this hw.le)]
    ring
  have hsum : Summable fun n => ∫ w in Ioi (0:ℝ), ‖F n w‖ := by
    simp only [hFnorm]
    exact summable_etaStar hx
  have key := integral_tsum_of_summable_integral_norm hFint hsum
  unfold S
  rw [tsum_congr fun n => (hFn n).symm, key]
  refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun w (hw : 0 < w) => ?_
  simp only [F]
  rw [← tsum_mul_right]
  refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_
  push_cast
  ring

/-- The trivial bound `|S_{η₂}(α, z)| ≤ 3 ψ(z) ≤ 17 z`. -/
theorem norm_S_eta2_le_trivial {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) (α : ℝ) : ‖S eta2 z α‖ ≤ 17 * z := by
  unfold S
  have hs : ∀ n ∉ Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1),
      ((Λ n * eta2 (n / z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α) = 0 := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt, Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.floor_lt hz.le] at hn
    rw [eta2_eq_zero, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul]
    rintro ⟨-, h1⟩
    rw [div_lt_one hz] at h1
    linarith
  rw [tsum_eq_sum hs]
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
  have h1 : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1),
      ‖((Λ n * eta2 (n / z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α)‖ ≤ 3 * Λ n := by
    intro n _
    rw [norm_mul, TernaryGoldbach.norm_e, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (eta2_nonneg _))]
    nlinarith [eta2_le (n / z), @ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg n]
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum h1).trans ?_
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hpsi : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1), Λ n = Chebyshev.psi z := by
    have e : Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1) = insert 0 (Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊z⌋₊) := by
      ext n; simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Ioc]; omega
    rw [e, Finset.sum_insert (by simp), ArithmeticFunction.map_zero, zero_add]
    rfl
  rw [hpsi]
  have h4 : Real.log 4 < 1.3863 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]
    have := Real.log_two_lt_d9; push_cast; linarith
  have := Chebyshev.psi_le_const_mul_self hz.le
  nlinarith

/-- The pointwise step of Prop 11.2.3′: a fresh approximation at scale `z = wy`. If
`α ∉ 𝔐_{8,n}(y)`, `z ≥ 2.16·10²⁰`, `min(1, w) n ≥ 670`, then `|S_{η₂}(α, z)| ≤ G z` for any `G`
with `G ≥ g_z(min(1, w) n)` (when `min(1, w) n ≤ z^{1/3}/6`) and `G z ≥` the second-case bound. -/
theorem norm_S_eta2_le_of_not_mem {α y n w G : ℝ} (hy0 : 0 < y) (hα : α ∉ majorArcs 8 n y)
    (hw0 : 0 < w) (hz : 2.16e20 ≤ w * y) (hlow : 670 ≤ min 1 w * n)
    (hG1 : min 1 w * n ≤ (w * y) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6 → gx (w * y) (min 1 w * n) ≤ G)
    (hG2 : 0.276 * (w * y) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * y) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) +
      1234 * (w * y) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * y) ≤ G * (w * y)) :
    ‖S eta2 (w * y) α‖ ≤ G * (w * y) := by
  set z := w * y with hz_def
  have hz0 : 0 < z := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hTz, -, hTz23, -⟩ := cube_root_facts hz
  have hQ1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 4 * z ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) := by rw [hTz23]; nlinarith
  obtain ⟨δ, a, q, h⟩ := exists_approx2 α hz0 hQ1
  have hy' : Approx2 α y (δ / w) a q (3 / 4 * z ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) := by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, ⟨k, hk⟩, h4, h5⟩ := h
    have e : δ / w / y = δ / z := by rw [hz_def]; field_simp
    exact ⟨h1, h2, ⟨k, by rw [e]; exact hk⟩, by rw [e]; exact h4, h5⟩
  have hr := le_rAlpha_of_not_mem hy0 (by norm_num) hy' hα
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ q := Nat.cast_nonneg q
  have hmm := min_mul_max_le hw0 (div_nonneg (abs_nonneg δ) hw0.le)
  have hrw : min 1 w * n ≤ max 1 (|δ| / 8) * q := by
    have e : w * (|δ| / w) / 8 = |δ| / 8 := by field_simp
    rw [e] at hmm
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hw0] at hr
    calc min 1 w * n ≤ min 1 w * (max 1 (|δ| / w / 8) * q) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr (le_min zero_le_one hw0.le)
      _ = min 1 w * max 1 (|δ| / w / 8) * q := by ring
      _ ≤ max 1 (|δ| / 8) * q := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmm hq0
  rcases le_or_gt (q : ℝ) (z ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6) with hq | hq

/-- The pointwise step of Prop 11.2.3′: a fresh approximation at scale `z = wy`. If
`α ∉ 𝔐_{8,n}(y)`, `z ≥ 2.16·10²⁰`, `min(1, w) n ≥ 670`, then `|S_{η₂}(α, z)| ≤ G z` for any `G`
with `G ≥ g_z(min(1, w) n)` (when `min(1, w) n ≤ z^{1/3}/6`) and `G z ≥` the second-case bound. -/
theorem norm_S_eta2_le_of_not_mem {α y n w G : ℝ} (hy0 : 0 < y) (hα : α ∉ majorArcs 8 n y)
    (hw0 : 0 < w) (hz : 2.16e20 ≤ w * y) (hlow : 670 ≤ min 1 w * n)
    (hG1 : min 1 w * n ≤ (w * y) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6 → gx (w * y) (min 1 w * n) ≤ G)
    (hG2 : 0.276 * (w * y) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * y) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) +
      1234 * (w * y) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * y) ≤ G * (w * y)) :
    ‖S eta2 (w * y) α‖ ≤ G * (w * y) := by
  set z := w * y with hz_def
  have hz0 : 0 < z := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hTz, -, hTz23, -⟩ := cube_root_facts hz
  have hQ1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 4 * z ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) := by rw [hTz23]; nlinarith
  obtain ⟨δ, a, q, h⟩ := exists_approx2 α hz0 hQ1
  have hy' : Approx2 α y (δ / w) a q (3 / 4 * z ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) := by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, ⟨k, hk⟩, h4, h5⟩ := h
    have e : δ / w / y = δ / z := by rw [hz_def]; field_simp
    exact ⟨h1, h2, ⟨k, by rw [e]; exact hk⟩, by rw [e]; exact h4, h5⟩
  have hr := le_rAlpha_of_not_mem hy0 (by norm_num) hy' hα
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ q := Nat.cast_nonneg q
  have hmm := min_mul_max_le hw0 (div_nonneg (abs_nonneg δ) hw0.le)
  have hrw : min 1 w * n ≤ max 1 (|δ| / 8) * q := by
    have e : w * (|δ| / w) / 8 = |δ| / 8 := by field_simp
    rw [e] at hmm
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hw0] at hr
    calc min 1 w * n ≤ min 1 w * (max 1 (|δ| / w / 8) * q) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr (le_min zero_le_one hw0.le)
      _ = min 1 w * max 1 (|δ| / w / 8) * q := by ring
      _ ≤ max 1 (|δ| / 8) * q := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmm hq0
  rcases le_or_gt (q : ℝ) (z ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6) with hq | hq
  · have key := norm_S_eta2_le_gx hz h hq (by linarith)
    have hup := r_le_cube_root hz h hq
    have hmono := gx_antitoneOn hz ⟨hlow, hrw.trans hup⟩ ⟨hlow.trans hrw, hup⟩ hrw
    calc ‖S eta2 z α‖ ≤ gx z (max 1 (|δ| / 8) * q) * z := key
      _ ≤ G * z := by
          gcongr
          exact hmono.trans (hG1 (hrw.trans hup))
  · exact ((theorem_3_1_1 hz h).2 hq).trans hG2

/-- The integration step of Prop 11.2.3: a pointwise bound `|S_{η₂}(α, wy)| ≤ G(w) wy` on
`[w₀, w₁]`, the trivial bound elsewhere. -/
theorem norm_S_etaStar_le_of_pointwise {α x w₀ w₁ : ℝ} {G : ℝ → ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hw₀ : 0 < w₀) (hw₀₁ : w₀ ≤ w₁)
    (hpw : ∀ w ∈ Icc w₀ w₁, ‖S eta2 (w * (x / κ)) α‖ ≤ G w * (w * (x / κ)))
    (hGi : IntegrableOn (fun w => G w * phi w) (Icc w₀ w₁)) :
    ‖S etaStar x α‖ ≤ x / κ * ((∫ w in Icc w₀ w₁, G w * phi w) +
      17 * ((∫ w in Ioo 0 w₀, phi w) + ∫ w in Ioi w₁, phi w)) := by
  have hκ : (0 : ℝ) < κ := by rw [TernaryGoldbach.Helfgott.κ]; norm_num
  set y := x / κ with hy_def
  have hy0 : 0 < y := div_pos hx hκ
  set B : ℝ → ℝ := fun w =>
    (Ioo 0 w₀).indicator (fun w => 17 * y * phi w) w +
      (Icc w₀ w₁).indicator (fun w => y * (G w * phi w)) w +
      (Ioi w₁).indicator (fun w => 17 * y * phi w) w with hB
  have hφi : IntegrableOn (fun w => 17 * y * phi w) univ :=
    (integrable_phi.const_mul (17 * y)).integrableOn
  have I1 : Integrable ((Ioo 0 w₀).indicator (fun w => 17 * y * phi w)) (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) :=
    (IntegrableOn.integrable_indicator (hφi.mono_set (subset_univ _)) measurableSet_Ioo).restrict
  have I2 : Integrable ((Icc w₀ w₁).indicator (fun w => y * (G w * phi w))) (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) :=
    (IntegrableOn.integrable_indicator (hGi.const_mul y) measurableSet_Icc).restrict
  have I3 : Integrable ((Ioi w₁).indicator (fun w => 17 * y * phi w)) (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) :=
    (IntegrableOn.integrable_indicator (hφi.mono_set (subset_univ _)) measurableSet_Ioi).restrict
  have I12 : Integrable (fun w => (Ioo 0 w₀).indicator (fun w => 17 * y * phi w) w +
      (Icc w₀ w₁).indicator (fun w => y * (G w * phi w)) w) (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) := I1.add I2
  have hBi : Integrable B (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) := I12.add I3
  have hpt : ∀ w ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), ‖S eta2 (w * y) α‖ * (phi w / w) ≤ B w := by
    intro w (hw : 0 < w)
    have hφw : 0 ≤ phi w / w := div_nonneg (phi_nonneg w) hw.le
    have triv : ‖S eta2 (w * y) α‖ * (phi w / w) ≤ 17 * y * phi w := by
      have := norm_S_eta2_le_trivial (mul_pos hw hy0) α
      calc ‖S eta2 (w * y) α‖ * (phi w / w) ≤ 17 * (w * y) * (phi w / w) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right this hφw
        _ = 17 * y * phi w := by field_simp
    rcases lt_or_ge w w₀ with h1 | h1
    · have : B w = 17 * y * phi w := by
        simp only [hB, indicator, mem_Ioo, mem_Icc, mem_Ioi, hw, h1, true_and, ite_true]
        rw [ite_eq_right (by intro h'; linarith [h'.1]), ite_eq_right (by intro h'; linarith)]; ring
      rw [this]; exact triv
    rcases le_or_gt w w₁ with h2 | h2
    · have hBw : B w = y * (G w * phi w) := by
        simp only [hB, indicator, mem_Ioo, mem_Icc, mem_Ioi]
        rw [ite_eq_right (by intro h'; linarith [h'.2]), ite_eq_left ⟨h1, h2⟩,
          ite_eq_right (by intro h'; linarith)]
        ring
      rw [hBw]
      calc ‖S eta2 (w * y) α‖ * (phi w / w) ≤ G w * (w * y) * (phi w / w) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hpw w ⟨h1, h2⟩) hφw
        _ = y * (G w * phi w) := by field_simp
    · have : B w = 17 * y * phi w := by
        simp only [hB, indicator, mem_Ioo, mem_Icc, mem_Ioi]
        rw [ite_eq_right (by intro h'; linarith [h'.2]), ite_eq_right (by intro h'; linarith [h'.2]),
          ite_eq_left h2]
        ring
      rw [this]; exact triv
  refine (norm_S_etaStar_le hx α).trans ?_
  have hf0 : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioi 0)] fun w => ‖S eta2 (w * y) α‖ * (phi w / w) :=
    (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun w (hw : 0 < w) =>
      mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (div_nonneg (phi_nonneg w) hw.le))
  refine (integral_mono_of_nonneg hf0 hBi
    ((ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpt))).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  simp only [hB]
  rw [integral_add I12 I3, integral_add I1 I2, setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_Ioo,
    setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_Icc, setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_Ioi,
    inter_eq_right.2 Ioo_subset_Ioi_self,
    (inter_eq_right (s := Ioi (0:ℝ)) (t := Icc w₀ w₁)).2
      (fun w (hw : w ∈ Icc w₀ w₁) => lt_of_lt_of_le hw₀ hw.1),
    (inter_eq_right (s := Ioi (0:ℝ)) (t := Ioi w₁)).2 (Ioi_subset_Ioi (by linarith)),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  ring

  have hsq : 0 < s * q := by positivity
  have hR : 1 ≤ Q₀ / (s * q) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hsq, one_mul]; rw [le_div_iff₀ hq0] at hsQ; exact hsQ
  have hLQ : 0 < Real.log Q + cE := by
    have : 0 < Real.log Q := Real.log_pos (by linarith)

  · -- `q < 2.2·10¹⁰`: the reduction to `Φ`

    (hQ₀ : 1e5 ≤ Q₀) (hδ₀ : 2 ≤ δ₀) (hx : (20000 * Q₀) ^ 2 ≤ x / (2 * δ₀))

      (Real.log (2 * Q₀) + 2) / (Real.log (2 * √(x / (2 * δ₀))) + cE) * ∑' n, ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := by

  · have h1 : Q₀ ^ 2 ≤ x / (2 * δ₀) := le_trans (by nlinarith) hx
    have h2 : δ₀ * Q₀ ^ 2 ≤ δ₀ * (x / (2 * δ₀)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by linarith)
    have h3 : δ₀ * (x / (2 * δ₀)) = x / 2 := by field_simp
    linarith

    have hlog : Real.log (2 * Q₀) ≤ 0.6 * Real.log (2 * Q) := by
      have := Real.log_le_log h2Q₀ hρ
      rwa [Real.log_rpow (by nlinarith)] at this
    exact prop_12_2_4 (by linarith) (by linarith) hlog hq hq2 hs hsq

theorem Farc_eq {L : ℕ} [NeZero L] {a : ℕ → ℂ} {δ₀ R x β : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (hqL : ∀ q ∈ Qset R, q ∣ L) (ha : Summable fun n => ‖a n‖)
    (hcop : ∀ n, a n ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime n L) :
    Farc a δ₀ R x β = ∑ Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L, ‖Schar Ψ⁻¹ a β‖ ^ 2 *
      (Ψ.conductor / Ψ.conductor.totient *
        (kap Ψ.conductor * Gq (qt Ψ.conductor) ((mR δ₀ R x β : ℕ) / qt Ψ.conductor))) := by
  classical
  have hT : ∀ q ∈ Qset R, ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ‖expTsum a ((b : ℝ) / q + β)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ Ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ L,
        (if Ψ.conductor ∣ q then TernaryGoldbach.wq q Ψ.conductor else 0) / q.totient *
          ‖Schar Ψ⁻¹ a β‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro q hq
    have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hq).1).1
    have : NeZero q := ⟨by omega⟩
    have hφ : (0 : ℝ) < q.totient := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.2 (by omega)
    rw [sum_Bset_eq_units (fun t => ‖expTsum a t‖ ^ 2) β]
    have key := totient_mul_sum_units_lift (hqL q hq) ha hcop β
    simp_rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← Finset.sum_div, ← key]
    field_simp
  unfold Farc
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q hq => by rw [hT q hq], ← Finset.sum_filter, Qset_filter_eq hx,
    Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun Ψ _ => ?_
  have hc1 : 1 ≤ Ψ.conductor := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (DirichletCharacter.conductor_ne_zero Ψ)
  rw [← weight_sum Ψ.conductor hc1, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  ring

theorem Farc_le {L : ℕ} [NeZero L] {a : ℕ → ℂ} {δ₀ Q₀ Q x β C : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hQ₀ : 1 ≤ Q₀)
    (hQQ : Q₀ ≤ Q) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C)
    (hC : ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → Even q → (q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q₀ → ∀ s : ℝ, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ 2 * Q₀ / q →
      Gq q (2 * Q₀ / (s * q)) ≤ C * Gq q (2 * Q / (s * q)))
    (hqL₀ : ∀ q ∈ Qset Q₀, q ∣ L) (hqL : ∀ q ∈ Qset Q, q ∣ L) (ha : Summable fun n => ‖a n‖)
    (hcop : ∀ n, a n ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime n L) :
    Farc a δ₀ Q₀ x β ≤ C * Farc a δ₀ Q x β := by
  rw [Farc_eq hx hqL₀ ha hcop, Farc_eq hx hqL ha hcop, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun Ψ _ => ?_
  have hc1 : 1 ≤ Ψ.conductor := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (DirichletCharacter.conductor_ne_zero Ψ)
  have hG := Gq_mR_le (δ₀ := δ₀) (x := x) (β := β) hx hQ₀ hQQ hC0 hC Ψ.conductor hc1
  have h1 : 0 ≤ ‖Schar Ψ⁻¹ a β‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h2 : 0 ≤ (Ψ.conductor : ℝ) / Ψ.conductor.totient := by positivity
  have h3 := kap_nonneg Ψ.conductor
  calc ‖Schar Ψ⁻¹ a β‖ ^ 2 * (Ψ.conductor / Ψ.conductor.totient *
        (kap Ψ.conductor * Gq (qt Ψ.conductor) ((mR δ₀ Q₀ x β : ℕ) / qt Ψ.conductor)))
      ≤ ‖Schar Ψ⁻¹ a β‖ ^ 2 * (Ψ.conductor / Ψ.conductor.totient *
        (kap Ψ.conductor * (C * Gq (qt Ψ.conductor) ((mR δ₀ Q x β : ℕ) / qt Ψ.conductor)))) := by
        gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- **`G_q(R) G_P(t) ≤ G_q(tR)`** if every prime `≤ R`, and every prime dividing `q`, divides `P`. -/
theorem Gq_mul_le {q P : ℕ} {R t : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hPR : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p : ℝ) ≤ R → p ∣ P) (hPq : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ q → p ∣ P) :
    Gq q R * Gq P t ≤ Gq q (t * R) := by
  set A := (Icc 1 ⌊R⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r q)
  set B := (Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r P)
  set C := (Icc 1 ⌊t * R⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r q)
  -- elements of `A` and `B` are coprime
  have hcop : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ b ∈ B, Nat.Coprime a b := by
    intro a ha b hb
    simp only [A, B, mem_filter, mem_Icc] at ha hb
    refine Nat.coprime_of_dvd fun p hp hpa hpb => ?_
    have hpa' : p ≤ a := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hpa
    have hpR : (p : ℝ) ≤ R :=
      (by exact_mod_cast hpa'.trans ha.1.2 : (p : ℝ) ≤ ⌊R⌋₊).trans (Nat.floor_le hR)
    have h1 : Nat.Coprime p b := (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (hPR p hp hpR) hb.2.symm)
    exact (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp).1 h1 hpb
  rw [Gq_eq, Gq_eq, Gq_eq, sum_mul_sum, ← sum_product']
  rw [sum_congr rfl fun x hx => (gf_mul (hcop x.1 (mem_product.1 hx).1 x.2 (mem_product.1 hx).2)).symm]
  -- the map `(a, b) ↦ ab` is injective on `A × B`
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun x : ℕ × ℕ => x.1 * x.2) (A ×ˢ B : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    simp only [coe_product, Set.mem_prod, mem_coe] at hx hy
    simp only at hxy
    have hx1 : 0 < x.1 := by simp only [A, mem_filter, mem_Icc] at hx; omega
    have hy1 : 0 < y.1 := by simp only [A, mem_filter, mem_Icc] at hy; omega
    have d1 : x.1 ∣ y.1 := (hcop x.1 hx.1 y.2 hy.2).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right ⟨x.2, by rw [← hxy]⟩
    have d2 : y.1 ∣ x.1 := (hcop y.1 hy.1 x.2 hx.2).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right ⟨y.2, by rw [hxy]⟩
    have e1 : x.1 = y.1 := Nat.dvd_antisymm d1 d2
    have e2 : x.2 = y.2 := by
      rw [e1] at hxy; exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hy1 hxy
    exact Prod.ext e1 e2
  rw [← sum_image (f := gf) hinj]
  refine sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg ?_ fun r _ _ => gf_nonneg r
  intro m hm
  obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hm
  have ha := (mem_product.1 hab).1
  have hb := (mem_product.1 hab).2
  simp only [A, B, mem_filter, mem_Icc] at ha hb
  simp only [C, mem_filter, mem_Icc]
  refine ⟨⟨Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (Nat.mul_ne_zero (by omega) (by omega)), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · apply Nat.le_floor
    push_cast
    have h1 : (a : ℝ) ≤ R := (by exact_mod_cast ha.1.2 : (a : ℝ) ≤ ⌊R⌋₊).trans (Nat.floor_le hR)
    have h2 : (b : ℝ) ≤ t := (by exact_mod_cast hb.1.2 : (b : ℝ) ≤ ⌊t⌋₊).trans (Nat.floor_le ht)
    rw [mul_comm (a : ℝ)]
    exact mul_le_mul h2 h1 (Nat.cast_nonneg _) ht

    refine Nat.coprime_of_dvd fun p hp hpb hpq => ?_
    have h1 : Nat.Coprime p b := Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (hPq p hp hpq) hb.2.symm

/-- **`G(t) ≤ (P/φ(P)) G_P(t)`** for squarefree `P` ([H, (12.11)]). -/
theorem G_le_mul_Gq {P : ℕ} (hP : Squarefree P) {t : ℝ} :
    Gq 1 t ≤ (P : ℝ) / Nat.totient P * Gq P t := by
  rw [← sum_divisors_gf hP, Gq_eq, Gq_eq, sum_mul_sum, ← sum_product']
  set B := (Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r P)
  -- restrict to squarefree `m`
  have hsq : ∑ m ∈ (Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r 1), gf m =
      ∑ m ∈ ((Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r 1)).filter Squarefree, gf m := by
    refine (sum_filter_of_ne fun m _ h => ?_).symm
    by_contra hs
    exact h (by simp [gf, ArithmeticFunction.moebius_eq_zero_of_not_squarefree hs])
  rw [hsq]
  set D := ((Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r 1)).filter Squarefree
  -- `m ↦ (gcd(m, P), m / gcd(m, P))`
  set φm : ℕ → ℕ × ℕ := fun m => (Nat.gcd m P, m / Nat.gcd m P)
  have hmem : ∀ m ∈ D, φm m ∈ P.divisors ×ˢ B := by
    intro m hm
    simp only [D, mem_filter, mem_Icc] at hm
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, -⟩, hsqf⟩ := hm
    have hg : 0 < Nat.gcd m P := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
    refine mem_product.2 ⟨Nat.mem_divisors.2 ⟨Nat.gcd_dvd_right m P, hP.ne_zero⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [B, mem_filter, mem_Icc]
    refine ⟨⟨?_, (Nat.div_le_self _ _).trans h2⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m P)) hg
    · -- `m/gcd(m,P)` is coprime to `P` since `m` is squarefree
      refine Nat.coprime_of_dvd fun p hp hp1 hp2 => ?_
      have hpm : p ∣ m := hp1.trans (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m P))
      have hpg : p ∣ Nat.gcd m P := Nat.dvd_gcd hpm hp2
      have : p * p ∣ m := by
        have e : m = Nat.gcd m P * (m / Nat.gcd m P) :=
          (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m P)).symm
        rw [e]; exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul hpg hp1
      exact hp.one_lt.ne' (Nat.isUnit_iff.1 (hsqf p this))
  have hval : ∀ m ∈ D, gf m = gf (φm m).1 * gf (φm m).2 := by
    intro m hm
    simp only [D, mem_filter] at hm
    have hcop : Nat.Coprime (Nat.gcd m P) (m / Nat.gcd m P) := by
      have hB := (mem_product.1 (hmem m (by simp only [D, mem_filter]; exact hm))).2
      simp only [B, mem_filter] at hB
      exact (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (Nat.gcd_dvd_right m P) hB.2.symm)
    rw [← gf_mul hcop, Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m P)]
  have hinj : Set.InjOn φm (D : Set ℕ) := by
    intro x _ y _ hxy
    have e1 := congrArg (fun z : ℕ × ℕ => z.1 * z.2) hxy
    simp only [φm, Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ P)] at e1
    exact e1
  rw [sum_congr rfl hval, ← sum_image (f := fun x : ℕ × ℕ => gf x.1 * gf x.2) hinj]
  exact sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (fun x hx => by
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hx; exact hmem m hm)
    fun x _ _ => mul_nonneg (gf_nonneg _) (gf_nonneg _)

theorem G_le_mul_Gq {P : ℕ} (hP : Squarefree P) {t : ℝ} :
    Gq 1 t ≤ (P : ℝ) / Nat.totient P * Gq P t := by
  rw [← sum_divisors_gf hP, Gq_eq, Gq_eq, sum_mul_sum, ← sum_product']
  set B := (Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r P)
  -- restrict to squarefree `m`
  have hsq : ∑ m ∈ (Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r 1), gf m =
      ∑ m ∈ ((Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r 1)).filter Squarefree, gf m := by
    refine (sum_filter_of_ne fun m _ h => ?_).symm
    by_contra hs
    exact h (by simp [gf, ArithmeticFunction.moebius_eq_zero_of_not_squarefree hs])
  rw [hsq]
  set D := ((Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r 1)).filter Squarefree
  -- `m ↦ (gcd(m, P), m / gcd(m, P))`
  set φm : ℕ → ℕ × ℕ := fun m => (Nat.gcd m P, m / Nat.gcd m P)
  have hmem : ∀ m ∈ D, φm m ∈ P.divisors ×ˢ B := by
    intro m hm
    simp only [D, mem_filter, mem_Icc] at hm
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, -⟩, hsqf⟩ := hm
    have hg : 0 < Nat.gcd m P := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
    refine mem_product.2 ⟨Nat.mem_divisors.2 ⟨Nat.gcd_dvd_right m P, hP.ne_zero⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [B, mem_filter, mem_Icc]
    refine ⟨⟨?_, (Nat.div_le_self _ _).trans h2⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m P)) hg
    · -- `m/gcd(m,P)` is coprime to `P` since `m` is squarefree
      refine Nat.coprime_of_dvd fun p hp hp1 hp2 => ?_
      have hpm : p ∣ m := hp1.trans (Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m P))
      have hpg : p ∣ Nat.gcd m P := Nat.dvd_gcd hpm hp2
      have : p * p ∣ m := by
        have e : m = Nat.gcd m P * (m / Nat.gcd m P) :=
          (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m P)).symm
        rw [e]; exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul hpg hp1
      exact hp.one_lt.ne' (Nat.isUnit_iff.1 (hsqf p this))
  have hval : ∀ m ∈ D, gf m = gf (φm m).1 * gf (φm m).2 := by
    intro m hm
    simp only [D, mem_filter] at hm
    have hcop : Nat.Coprime (Nat.gcd m P) (m / Nat.gcd m P) := by
      have hB := (mem_product.1 (hmem m (by simp only [D, mem_filter]; exact hm))).2
      simp only [B, mem_filter] at hB
      exact (Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left (Nat.gcd_dvd_right m P) hB.2.symm)
    rw [← gf_mul hcop, Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m P)]
  have hinj : Set.InjOn φm (D : Set ℕ) := by
    intro x _ y _ hxy
    have e1 := congrArg (fun z : ℕ × ℕ => z.1 * z.2) hxy
    simp only [φm, Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ P)] at e1
    exact e1
  rw [sum_congr rfl hval, ← sum_image (f := fun x : ℕ × ℕ => gf x.1 * gf x.2) hinj]
  exact sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (fun x hx => by
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := mem_image.1 hx; exact hmem m hm)

        refine ⟨⟨⟨hr1, Nat.le_floor (le_trans ?_ h)⟩, by rw [hq]; exact h, hcop⟩, hodd⟩
        exact_mod_cast Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left r (by omega)
    · -- even `r = 2r'`
      have hB : ∑ r ∈ B, (μ r : ℝ) ^ 2 / r.totient =
          ∑ r' ∈ (Icc 1 ⌊X / ((2 * c : ℕ) : ℝ)⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r c),
            ((μ (2 * r') : ℝ)) ^ 2 / (2 * r').totient := by
        simp_rw [moebius_sq_div_totient_two_mul]
        rw [← sum_filter, filter_filter]
        refine sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
        ext r
        simp only [B, mem_filter, Nat.coprime_mul_iff_right]
        tauto
      rw [hB]
      refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun r => r / 2) (fun r' => 2 * r') ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro r hr
        simp only [A, mem_filter, mem_Icc, Nat.not_odd_iff_even] at hr ⊢
        obtain ⟨⟨⟨hr1, -⟩, hrX, hcop⟩, hev⟩ := hr
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hev
        have hk : k + k = 2 * k := by ring
        rw [hk] at hr1 hrX hcop ⊢
        rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (by norm_num)]
        have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
        have hq : qt (c * (2 * k)) = 2 * c * k := by
          unfold qt; rw [if_pos ((even_two_mul k).mul_left c)]; ring
        rw [hq] at hrX
        exact ⟨⟨hk1, (le_floor_div_iff hk1 (by omega) X).2 hrX⟩,
          Nat.Coprime.coprime_mul_left hcop⟩
      · intro r' hr'
        simp only [A, mem_filter, mem_Icc, Nat.not_odd_iff_even] at hr' ⊢
        obtain ⟨⟨hr1, hrX⟩, hcop⟩ := hr'
        have hq : qt (c * (2 * r')) = 2 * c * r' := by
          unfold qt; rw [if_pos ((even_two_mul r').mul_left c)]; ring
        have h := (le_floor_div_iff hr1 (by omega) X).1 hrX
        refine ⟨⟨⟨by omega, Nat.le_floor (le_trans ?_ h)⟩, by rw [hq]; exact h, ?_⟩, even_two_mul r'⟩
        · push_cast; nlinarith [show (1:ℝ) ≤ c by exact_mod_cast hc, show (0:ℝ) ≤ r' by positivity]
        · exact Nat.Coprime.mul_left ((Nat.coprime_two_left).2 hco) hcop
      · intro r hr
        simp only [A, mem_filter, Nat.not_odd_iff_even] at hr
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hr.2
        omega
      · intro r' _; omega
      · intro r hr
        simp only [A, mem_filter, Nat.not_odd_iff_even] at hr
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hr.2
        rw [show k + k = 2 * k by ring, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (by norm_num)]

proof.summary: `wrad_add_le` bounds the sum of two arc radii by the reciprocal of qq', and `arcs_unique` uses it to show the arcs are pairwise disjoint.

annotation.note: Lean proves disjointness for the (10.5) arcs of radius $\delta_0Q/(\tilde qx)$ over $\tilde q\le 2Q$ (odd q doubled, spacing constant D = 1 or 2), not the text's arcs of radius $1/2qQ$ over $q\le Q$.

proof_context.conclusion: From $\delta_0Q^2\le x/2$: $\delta_0Q/x\le 1/(2Q)$, so $w_q+w_{q'}\le D/(qq')$ ($D=2$ if both even, else 1) for $\tilde q,\tilde q'\le 2Q$.

theorem wrad_add_le {δ₀ Q x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ₀) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQx : δ₀ * Q ^ 2 ≤ x / 2)
    {q q' : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hq' : 1 ≤ q') (hqQ : (qt q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q) (hqQ' : (qt q' : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q) :
    wrad δ₀ Q x q + wrad δ₀ Q x q' ≤ (if Even q ∧ Even q' then 2 else 1) / (q * q') := by
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hqr' : (0 : ℝ) < q' := by exact_mod_cast hq'
  -- `δ₀Q/x ≤ 1/(2Q)`
  have hk : δ₀ * Q / x ≤ 1 / (2 * Q) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hx (by positivity)]; nlinarith
  have hw : ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → wrad δ₀ Q x p ≤ 1 / (2 * Q * qt p) := by
    intro p hp
    have hp2 : (0 : ℝ) < qt p := by have := two_le_qt hp; exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < qt p)
    unfold wrad
    rw [show δ₀ * Q / (qt p * x) = δ₀ * Q / x / qt p by field_simp]
    calc δ₀ * Q / x / qt p ≤ 1 / (2 * Q) / qt p := by gcongr
      _ = 1 / (2 * Q * qt p) := by field_simp
  refine (add_le_add (hw q hq) (hw q' hq')).trans ?_
  unfold qt at hqQ hqQ' ⊢
  by_cases he : Even q <;> by_cases he' : Even q' <;> simp only [he, he', if_true, if_false,
    and_self, and_true, and_false] at hqQ hqQ' ⊢ <;> push_cast at hqQ hqQ' ⊢ <;>
    rw [div_add_div _ _ (by positivity) (by positivity), div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)] <;>
    nlinarith [mul_pos hqr hqr', mul_pos (mul_pos hqr hqr') hQ]

proof_context.conclusion: Arcs $J_{q,b}$ at level $Q$ (and their integer translates) are pairwise disjoint: overlapping arcs force $cq'=c'q$, hence $(q,b,k)=(q',b',k')$.

snippet.text:
/-- **The arcs at level `Q` are disjoint** (`δ₀Q² ≤ x/2`): if `α − k ∈ J_{q,b}` and
`α − k' ∈ J_{q',b'}`, then `(q, b, k) = (q', b', k')`. -/
theorem arcs_unique {δ₀ Q x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ₀) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQx : δ₀ * Q ^ 2 ≤ x / 2)
    {α : ℝ} {q b q' b' : ℕ} {k k' : ℤ} (hq : q ∈ Qset Q) (hb : b ∈ Bset q) (hq' : q' ∈ Qset Q)
    (hb' : b' ∈ Bset q') (h1 : α - k ∈ arc δ₀ Q x q b) (h2 : α - k' ∈ arc δ₀ Q x q' b') :
    q = q' ∧ b = b' ∧ k = k' := by
  obtain ⟨hq1, hqQ⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hq
  obtain ⟨hq1', hqQ'⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hq'
  have hq1 := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq1).1
  have hq1' := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq1').1
  obtain ⟨hbq, hbc⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hb
  obtain ⟨hbq', hbc'⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hb'
  have hbq := Finset.mem_range.1 hbq
  have hbq' := Finset.mem_range.1 hbq'
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  have hqr' : (0 : ℝ) < q' := by exact_mod_cast hq1'
  set c : ℤ := b + k * q
  set c' : ℤ := b' + k' * q'
  have hc : (c : ℝ) / q = b / q + k := by simp only [c]; push_cast; field_simp
  have hc' : (c' : ℝ) / q' = b' / q' + k' := by simp only [c']; push_cast; field_simp
  have hdist : |(c : ℝ) / q - c' / q'| < wrad δ₀ Q x q + wrad δ₀ Q x q' := by
    obtain ⟨h11, h12⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨h21, h22⟩ := h2
    rw [hc, hc', abs_sub_lt_iff]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hW := wrad_add_le hx hδ hQ hQx hq1 hq1' hqQ hqQ'
  -- `cq' = c'q`
  have hcross : c * q' = c' * q := by
    by_contra hne
    set N : ℤ := c * q' - c' * q
    have hN : N ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hne
    have hexpr : (c : ℝ) / q - c' / q' = N / (q * q') := by
      simp only [N]; push_cast; field_simp
    rw [hexpr, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < q * q')] at hdist
    have hD : (if Even q ∧ Even q' then (2 : ℝ) else 1) ≤ |(N : ℝ)| := by
      split_ifs with hev
      · have hNe : Even N := by
          have e1 : Even (c * q') := ((Int.even_coe_nat q').2 hev.2).mul_left c
          have e2 : Even (c' * q) := ((Int.even_coe_nat q).2 hev.1).mul_left c'
          exact e1.sub e2
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hNe
        have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hm; exact hN hm
        have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |m| := Int.one_le_abs hm0
        rw [hm]; push_cast
        rw [show (m : ℝ) + m = 2 * m by ring, abs_mul]
        have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(m : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast this
        norm_num; linarith
      · exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hN
    have := lt_of_lt_of_le hdist hW
    rw [div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right (by positivity)] at this
    linarith
  -- coprimality gives `q = q'`
  have hcop : IsCoprime c q := by
    have : IsCoprime (b : ℤ) q := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hbc
    simpa [c] using this.add_mul_right_left k
  have hcop' : IsCoprime c' q' := by
    have : IsCoprime (b' : ℤ) q' := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hbc'
    simpa [c'] using this.add_mul_right_left k'
  have hd1 : (q : ℤ) ∣ q' := by
    have : (q : ℤ) ∣ c * q' := ⟨c', by rw [hcross]; ring⟩
    exact hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left this
  have hd2 : (q' : ℤ) ∣ q := by
    have : (q' : ℤ) ∣ c' * q := ⟨c, by rw [← hcross]; ring⟩
    exact hcop'.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left this
  have hqq : q = q' := by
    have := Int.dvd_antisymm (by positivity) (by positivity) hd1 hd2
    exact_mod_cast this
  subst hqq
  have hcc : c = c' := by
    have hq0 : (q : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : q ≠ 0)
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hq0 hcross
  -- `b + kq = b' + k'q` with `0 ≤ b, b' < q`
  have hkk : k = k' := by
    have h : ((b : ℤ) - b') = (k' - k) * q := by simp only [c, c'] at hcc; linarith
    by_contra hne
    have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |k' - k| := Int.one_le_abs (sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm hne))
    have hlt : |(b : ℤ) - b'| < q := by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> omega
    rw [h, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hq1 : (0:ℤ) < q)] at hlt
    nlinarith
  subst hkk
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_, rfl⟩
  have : (b : ℤ) = b' := by simp only [c, c'] at hcc; linarith
  exact_mod_cast this

proof_context.conclusion: `α ∈ majorArcs δ₀ R x` iff some `q ≥ 1` with `q̃ ≤ 2R` (`q̃ = q` even, `2q` odd) and `a` coprime to `q` has `|α - a/q| < δ₀R/(q̃x)`, i.e. the odd/even radii of (majdef) in one uniform form.

theorem mem_majorArcs_iff {δ₀ R x α : ℝ} :
    α ∈ majorArcs δ₀ R x ↔ ∃ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧ (qt q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * R ∧ ∃ a : ℤ, IsCoprime a q ∧
      |α - a / q| < wrad δ₀ R x q := by
  simp only [majorArcs, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_Ioo, exists_prop]
  have hodd : ∀ q : ℕ, ¬ Even q → wrad δ₀ R x q = δ₀ * R / (2 * q * x) := fun q h => by
    unfold wrad qt; rw [if_neg h]; push_cast; ring_nf
  have hev : ∀ q : ℕ, Even q → wrad δ₀ R x q = δ₀ * R / (q * x) := fun q h => by
    unfold wrad qt; rw [if_pos h]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨q, ⟨hq1, hqR, ho⟩, a, hcop, h1, h2⟩ | ⟨q, ⟨hq1, hqR, he⟩, a, hcop, h1, h2⟩)
    · have hne : ¬ Even q := Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 ho
      refine ⟨q, hq1, ?_, a, hcop, ?_⟩
      · unfold qt; rw [if_neg hne]; push_cast; linarith
      · rw [hodd q hne, abs_sub_lt_iff]; constructor <;> linarith
    · refine ⟨q, hq1, ?_, a, hcop, ?_⟩
      · unfold qt; rw [if_pos he]; exact hqR
      · rw [hev q he, abs_sub_lt_iff]; constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨q, hq1, hqR, a, hcop, h⟩
    rw [abs_sub_lt_iff] at h
    by_cases he : Even q
    · right
      refine ⟨q, ⟨hq1, ?_, he⟩, a, hcop, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold qt at hqR; rw [if_pos he] at hqR; exact hqR
      · rw [hev q he] at h; linarith
      · rw [hev q he] at h; linarith
    · left
      refine ⟨q, ⟨hq1, ?_, Nat.not_even_iff_odd.1 he⟩, a, hcop, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold qt at hqR; rw [if_neg he] at hqR; push_cast at hqR; linarith
      · rw [hodd q he] at h; linarith
      · rw [hodd q he] at h; linarith
